title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description_clean:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!
Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.
This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.
Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems.
This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.
What you will do

Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.
Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.
Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.
Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.
Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.
Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

What we offer you
At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.
Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.
Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.
Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.
A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.

About Smartly
Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.
We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.
Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).
 
 
 
VOTRE RÔLE

Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Vous imaginez de nouveaux langages graphiques, développez des concepts créatifs avec le Brand Concepts Director et accompagnez leur déploiement sur l'ensemble des points de contact.
 
VOS MISSIONS

Participer au développement des concepts créatifs des projets spéciaux, collaborations et initiatives de Brand Expansion.
Participer au développement des identités visuelles des campagnes, collections, défilés et projets spéciaux, de leur conception à leur déclinaison.
Développer les systèmes graphiques, lettrages, traitements typographiques et directions artistiques associés.
Réaliser des recherches créatives, iconographiques et graphiques pour alimenter les réflexions du Studio Image.

description_clean:

To support our growth, we are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to join our HR team in Paris.
You will manage recruitment processes end-to-end, from understanding the hiring need and identifying the right sourcing strategy to interviewing candidates, managing the selection process and closing the hire.
A significant part of your activity will involve recruiting technical and highly specialized profiles, including Software Engineers, AI and Research profiles, Infrastructure experts, senior technical specialists and, depending on business needs, leadership and C-level positions.
You will work with a wide variety of stakeholders across the company: experienced hiring managers, technical experts, senior leaders and managers who may need more guidance throughout the recruitment process. Being able to adapt your approach, challenge when necessary and keep recruitment processes moving will therefore be an important part of your role.
You will join a collaborative Talent Acquisition team composed of a Talent Acquisition Team Lead, another Talent Acquisition Manager and an HR team member combining recruitment with broader HR projects, within the HR department.
We are looking for someone who is already comfortable managing recruitment independently, while remaining curious and eager to learn, develop their expertise and adopt our recruitment practices.
What you will do


Manage recruitment processes from A to Z, from the initial briefing with the hiring manager through sourcing, interviews, coordination of the selection process, offer management and contract signature.


Partner with hiring managers to understand their needs, challenge requirements when relevant and translate them into an effective recruitment and sourcing strategy.


Recruit across a variety of roles, with a strong focus on technical and complex profiles, including senior Software Engineers, AI/Research profiles, Infrastructure specialists, technical leadership and other hard-to-find profiles.


Take ownership of direct sourcing and headhunting, identifying and engaging passive candidates rather than relying primarily on inbound applications.


Build relevant talent pools and continuously explore new sourcing channels, tools and approaches.


Conduct structured interviews to assess candidates' experience, skills, motivations and potential fit with the role and environment.


Provide hiring managers with clear, fact-based candidate assessments and recommendations throughout the selection process.


Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment journey and contribute to a professional, transparent and engaging candidate experience.


Adapt your way of working to different stakeholders, from very experienced senior leaders to managers who require more support in structuring their recruitment process.


Keep our ATS and recruitment data accurate and up to date and contribute to the monitoring of key recruitment indicators.


Share market insights with the team and hiring managers, including candidate availability, compensation expectations, competitive dynamics and sourcing challenges.


Contribute to continuous improvement projects within Talent Acquisition, such as sourcing practices, interview methodologies, candidate experience, automation, documentation and recruitment processes.


Work closely with the rest of the Talent Acquisition and HR team, sharing knowledge, candidates, sourcing techniques and best practices.


What we are looking for

You already have a first solid experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally around 3 to 5 years, either in-house or in a recruitment agency/search environment.


You are able to manage a recruitment process independently from initial briefing to hire, while knowing when to ask for input or collaborate with the team.


You have already recruited technical and/or particularly complex profiles. Previous exposure to Software Engineering, AI/Data, Infrastructure, Research or senior technical positions would be particularly relevant.


You are comfortable working on senior and hard-to-find profiles and understand that some searches require persistence, creativity and a highly targeted approach.


Direct sourcing is part of your recruiter DNA: you are comfortable approaching passive candidates and using tools and techniques such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, talent mapping and other relevant sourcing channels.


You are comfortable interacting with stakeholders at different levels of seniority, including senior leaders and C-level executives, and can adapt your communication and level of guidance accordingly.


You know how to manage several recruitment processes simultaneously, prioritize effectively and maintain momentum even when working with busy stakeholders.


You combine autonomy with a strong team mindset: you take ownership of your searches but naturally share information, help colleagues and contribute to collective recruitment goals.


You are curious and eager to keep developing your recruitment expertise. You already have strong foundations, but you are still keen to learn new approaches, tools and practices.


You have strong interpersonal and communication skills and care about building high-quality relationships with both candidates and hiring managers.


Ability to build, manage and improve recruitment dashboards would be a strong plus for this role.


You are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.


Spanish would be a strong plus, as would experience recruiting across several European or international markets.

A structured onboarding program to discover our product, technology, teams and culture.


The opportunity to work on challenging searches across Software Engineering, AI, Infrastructure, Product, business and leadership roles.


Exposure to an international environment and stakeholders across multiple countries.


A Talent Acquisition team where you can operate autonomously while continuing to learn and develop your expertise.


The opportunity to contribute to the evolution of our recruitment practices and have a visible impact on how we attract and hire talent.


An office in the heart of Paris, close to Opéra Garnier.


A hybrid working model, with up to 2 days of remote work per week.


Lunch vouchers (€11/day via Swile).


High-quality IT equipment.

Regular company and team events

An annual gross package (fix +performance based bonus) ranging from 50 000 euros to 55 000 euros.

Make identity verification provider-agnostic: Replace today’s tightly coupled solution with one service that any team at Qonto can use, whichever provider runs the checks. This is mostly Ruby (90%), with some Go (10%)

Own the web side of provider integrations: Load provider SDKs in the browser, handle the errors they return, and keep the web part running as usage scales. Expect roughly half your time on web at first, moving towards 30% as the work shifts to the backend.

Backend experience: You’ve built and run backend services in production, and you’re at ease being backend-first.

Range across the stack: You’ll own changes across backend and web, partnering with our staff web engineer on architecture and complex integrations.
Ruby, or the will to learn it: Ruby experience is a plus, not a requirement.

➡️ What we can offer you

Platform work with real users: You build infrastructure behind KYC, the first step every customer takes with Qonto, and you see its effect in the conversion numbers.
Build reliable verification flows: Handle provider failures and retries, improve observability, and help the team operate integrations safely in production.
A design problem with real trade-offs: We work with several verification providers, each with its own SDK, errors and behaviour. You’ll design the layer that makes them interchangeable, and untangle today’s tightly coupled solution so that changing a provider no longer touches every consumer.
A platform other teams build on: KYC is our first internal customer, with other teams potentially following, such as Security for password reset checks. You'll build reliable APIs that other Qonto teams can depend on, while making the verification journey smoother, clearer, and more reliable for our customers.
Support from day one: An onboarding buddy from week two, and a weekly one-to-one with your manager.

Your manager will be Nicola, our Engineering Manager.

His goal is to build confident, independent engineers who take ownership of their work.

title: Devops Engineer
description_clean:
As a DevOps Engineer, you will be an integral part of an existing team comprising sixseven DevOps professionals. You will play a vital role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure and the internal platform built on it, which serves over 1800+ client companies, with 2.5+ million registered users and 30,000 daily active users. 
You will collaborate closely with all engineering squads including Development, Architecture, AI, and Data teams, to ensure the smooth and efficient delivery of our SaaS product. Our objective is to treat our infrastructure as a product for our developers, managing its complexity so they don’t have to. We provide simple, ready-to-use tools that enable them to build, deploy, and run their services efficiently.. Your expertise will be crucial in driving continuous improvement and fostering innovation within our DevOps and Platform Engineering practices.

You will have the opportunity to:
- Make a tangible impact in a rapidly evolving company. You will be responsible for building and maintaining a scalable infrastructure (accommodating more developers, more customers, and expansion into more countries) while optimizing resources (monitoring costs, reducing toil, and improving time to market) to support our growing activities.
- Engage in the continuous enhancement of our practices and undertake challenging and comprehensive projects. If you are interested in topics like SRE practices and platform engineering, you will play a key role in our transformation.
- Establish your own niche within a highly-skilled team that is eager to learn, share knowledge, and progress together.
Within 1 month, you will
Discover 360Learning, its platform, its teams and its culture.
Become familiar with our R&D way of working.
Understand the team’s processes.
Within 3 months, you will
Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using tools like Terraform, Ansible and Helm.
Automate the deployment of applications, configurations and infrastructure to achieve a high level of flexibility and confidence in production setups and deployment processes.
Improve our global security, challenge our worldwide scaling, increase our performance.
Within 6 months, you will:
Collaborate with other squads to implement and improve our DevOps practices.
Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions to improve system stability and availability.
Manage and maintain our Azure cloud infrastructure.
Ensure the security and compliance of our systems and data.
Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support.
Manage incidents and post-mortem.
Work closely with developers to facilitate their daily tasks, help them conform to best practices and ensure environments meet requirements  (e.g.: simplify and automate the deployment process, provide metrics and monitoring to the engineering squads).
Build and improve our internal platform: easy-to-deploy tools and templates that move infrastructure work off the squads' plate ("shift down"), so developers can ship without being infrastructure experts.
Improve monitoring and load testing to secure and enhance the performance of our infrastructure
Within 12 months, you will:
Actively participate in DevOps decisions for all critical projects related to our platform’s performance and reliability.
Evangelize and train our R&D team on Devops culture by defining all best practices and building them into the platform by default.
The Skill Set
3+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar role.
Ideally, you have worked in a tech or a SaaS company
You know how to run systems in production
Interest in platform engineering and developer experience: you like building tools that other engineers enjoy using
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, GitOps).
Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong understanding of networking, security, and system administration.
You have a coding background (scripting, programming)
Passion for automation and continuous improvement.
You have working proficiency in English (level B2 or equivalent)Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR)
Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here:  https://bit.ly/Convexity_360L


Our technical stack


Cloud: Azure Cloud


Container orchestration: k8s, ArgoCD


Infra as Code: Terraform, AnsibleHelm


Monitoring tool: Datadog


Database: MongoDB Atlas


Application language: Javascript


What we offer:
Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈
Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent. 
Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝
Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍
Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture:https://bit.ly/Convexity_360L & find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager
Discovery Meeting with our Lead Devops Engineer
Case Study to do at home and to discuss with a Devops Engineer
Clarification Meeting with a Devops Engineer
Culture-fit Meeting with our VP Engineering

With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place. 360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) Freelance
description_clean:
Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) 
Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées
À propos de l'opportunité
Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.
En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.
Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.
Vos missions


Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.


Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.


Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.


Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.


Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.


Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.


Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.


Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.


Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.


Ce que nous recherchons
Indispensable


Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.


Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.


Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.


Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.


La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.


Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.


La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.


Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.


La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.


Atouts


Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.


Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.


Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.
Rémunération
Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.
Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :


Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.


Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.


Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.


Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.


Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.


Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.


Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.
Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.
Formation et accompagnement
Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.
Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.
Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.Job Application Tip
We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer - Product Builder
description_clean: Chez Seyna, notre mission est simple: permettre aux professionnels de l'assurance de protéger ceux qui voient grand.Rejoins notre mission ! 🚀Seyna est un assureur qui apporte une efficacité incomparable aux courtiers. clairement le vrai problème avant d'écrire la moindre ligne de code.Tu apprends vite et tu adores plonger dans un métier qui n'est pas le tien.Tu es orienté(e) impact : tu mesures ce que tu livres et une insurtech à forte ambition (FT120) !NOTRE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT :En moyenne, notre processus de recrutement dure 2 à 3 semaines ! la compréhension du problème jusqu'à sa mise en production.⭐ De 3 à 12 mois — Devenir pleinement autonomeTu pilotes ton périmètre avec beaucoup d'autonomie : comprendre les problèmes, identifier les opportunités, définir les priorités, construire les bons sujets avec l'équipe et mesurer leur impact.🎯 Objectif : être pleinement responsable de l'impact produit de ton périmètre et contribuer activement à faire évoluer notre manière de construire le produit. Les compétences qu’on recherche Tu as 3+ ans d'expérience en Product Management, idéalement sur un produit SaaS B2B.Tu es à l'aise simple.Tu es à l'aise aussi bien avec les utilisateurs qu'avec les équipes techniques.Tu sais utiliser la donnée pour challenger tes intuitions et mesurer l'impact de ce que tu construis.Tu es écrire des requêtes SQL pour explorer toi-même les données ;tu as utilisé des outils no-code / low-code pour prototyper, automatiser ou tester rapidement une idée ;tu te débrouilles sur Figma et différence entre un kWc et un kWh.Mais Solteo c’est aussi…Un cadre professionnel vivant et énergique, où la prise d’initiatives est non seulement appréciée mais également récompensée.La chance de parfaire et d'enrichir tes connaissances dans un secteur en pleine croissance et qui a du sens.Des bureaux situés en plein centre de Paris, avec plusieurs autres start-ups du solaireUne diversité de projets captivants, offrant l'opportunité de collaborer avec des clients diverses et variés. title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description_clean:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Switzerland.
Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.
Accountabilities

Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

Requirements

Education: A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable.
Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, instrumentation, spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical method development.
Research or laboratory experience: Experience in laboratory-based research, analytical method validation, pharmaceutical or environmental testing, instrumentation-intensive studies, or related scientific applications is highly desirable.
Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures.
Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning.
Written communication: Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly, precisely, and logically.
Analytical thinking: Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and document reproducible findings.
AI training readiness: Interest in evaluating AI-generated content, identifying model limitations, and contributing to the development of more reliable scientific AI systems.
Working arrangements: Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment, manage assignments effectively, and provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

Benefits

Competitive hourly compensation: A pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the final rate determined by expertise, professional experience, and geographic location. The final offer may vary from the advertised range.
Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility associated with a freelance contract arrangement.
Meaningful scientific impact: Help shape AI systems that may support scientific education, research, analytical problem-solving, and laboratory workflows.
Intellectually stimulating work: Apply advanced analytical chemistry knowledge to challenging scientific questions and emerging AI evaluation tasks.
Specialized professional contribution: Use your research, instrumentation, and laboratory expertise in an innovative technology-focused environment.

title: Senior Radiochemist
description_clean:
ABOUT US
Transmutex is a Swiss company founded in 2019. Transmutex is currently advancing the HI-BEAM (High Intensity Breakthrough Engineering for Advanced Medicine) project, an ambitious programme to develop an industrial-scale facility for the reliable production of medical-grade Actinium-225 (Ac-225), a critical radionuclide for emerging targeted alpha therapies. 
Our team spans nuclear physics, engineering, software, radiochemistry, pharmaceutical and industrial development. Working with research labs and industrial partners worldwide, we are building the production capacity needed for the next generation of cancer treatments.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As the HI-BEAM project progresses from conceptual design into experimental validation, Transmutex is expanding its radiochemistry capability to translate established laboratory methods—supported by collaboration with leading international research institutes—into automated, reproducible, and commercially viable production processes.
We are seeking a Senior radiochemist to actively contribute to the technical design of Transmutex’ s radiochemistry process, in strong collaboration with renowned research labs. You will report to the Head of Extraction unit and be part of a small international team
You will primarily be based in Vernier, GE, with regular travel to Villigen, AG and to partner research labs in North America.
MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
Process development:

Design and optimize radiochemical separation and purification.
Collaborate across teams to develop radiochemical processes and methodology.
Perform radiochemical and chemical analyses, including alpha and gamma spectrometry.
Track radiochemistry developments and adopt relevant innovations and best practices.

Industrialization and operations:

Develop the radiochemical process flowsheet, including unit operations, process parameters, material balances, cycle times and waste streams.
cale up and transfer laboratory processes to a robust and GMP-compliant production line.
Define process, equipment, utility, instrumentation and facility-interface requirements.
Support equipment selection, sizing, qualification, commissioning and process validation.
Develop operating procedures, batch records, control strategies and consumables requirements.
Prepare laboratory and production operations aligned with capacity and customer needs.
Train and mentor colleagues.

Compliance, quality, and safety:

Work with QA and Safety to ensure regulatory compliance and meet applicable standards
Implement and monitor safety protocols and regulatory requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS
The candidates we are looking for must have:

PhD or Master’s degree in Radiochemistry, Nuclear Chemistry or related field
A minimum of 10 years of experience in radiochemistry.
Proven experience in radiochemical separation and purification with strong knowledge of actinide chemistry.
In-depth understanding of radiochemistry processes, equipment and tools.
Mastery of characterization, alpha or gamma spectrometry, ICP-MS, ICP-OES, liquid scintillation counting, or comparable analytical techniques.
Demonstrated knowledge of safety, radioprotection and GMP regulations and requirements. 
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to collaborate effectively with multiple internal and external stakeholders across disciplines. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address complex technical challenges.
Proven experience in translating lab-scale processes to GMP production line would be an asset
Fluent in English. Excellent knowledge of French or German would be an asset

TERMS AND CONDITIONS

Start date:          early 2027, and no later than April 2027
Location:            Vernier, GE, with monthly presence at Villigen, AG; Switzerland. This position also involves regular travels to North America.
Contract:            Full-time, permanent employment contract
Package:             We offer competitive remuneration and social security, accident/disability insurance and pension plans; one day per week work from home, as well as five weeks’ paid vacation.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS:
One to two technical interviews with the hiring manager, HR and other Transmutex team members; interview with Management for shortlisted candidates. At least one interview will be organized on-site in Geneva.

description_clean: Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description_clean: The product you will work onThe HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform.The ideal candidate isWe are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production.This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field.Your role and responsibilitiesYou will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams.Build the platformArchitect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters.Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions.Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment.Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations.Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services.Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior.Run what you buildOwn the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. All of it is infrastructure as code.Operate and evolve the on-premises Kubernetes footprint at venues, including air-gapped and intermittently connected installations.Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code.Be part of a compensated on-call rotationSet the technical directionAdvise and collaborate with product teams on building distributed systems that are scalable, secure, and observable, and review their designs with production reality in mind.Research and introduce tools and technologies where they measurably improve how we build and operate.Contribute back to the open-source projects we depend on, through issues and fixes.What you need to succeed in this roleSeveral years of professional software engineering experience, most of it spent designing and shipping production systems.Fluency in software engineering as a craft: concurrency, error handling, testing, and designing APIs that other teams build on.Working knowledge of the Kubernetes control plane and the operator/controller pattern, including how clusters behave when they are unhealthy.Hands-on experience with AWS, and a firm belief in infrastructure as code. Terraform and Ansible are what we use today.Comfort across several languages, and the ability to pick up a new one when the problem calls for it. Our platform work is mostly Go and Python, with Rust and C++ elsewhere in the stack.Experience building distributed systems, and a clear understanding of how they fail: partitions, partial rollouts, clock skew, retries, and reconciliation.A good sense for software architecture and maintainability, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can pick up and change.A strong command of Linux, scripting, and automation.Experience instrumenting software for telemetry and using it to answer real questions about running systems.Good judgment about what to automate and what to leave alone.Strong communication skills in English. You can explain a design or a failure clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists.Willingness to take part in compensated on-call and weekend work when installations need it.A can-do mentality, an eye for detail, and the courage to take on problems outside your comfort zone.Experience in using AI for engineering.Nice to havesExperience with NATS, Prometheus/Thanos, or PostgreSQL in production.Experience with air-gapped or intermittently connected installations.Experience running Kubernetes in production, not only deploying to it.Experience with embedded Linux, device fleet management, or IoT security.Networking depth: multicast at scale, WireGuard, BGP, IPv6.Experience in the audio, broadcast, or live events industry.Contributions to open-source infrastructure projectsWe offer youAt HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching.Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description_clean:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Trainers Network – Arabic based in Germany.
Join a global network of language professionals and culturally aware contributors helping shape the future of artificial intelligence.In this flexible, remote opportunity, you can contribute to projects that improve the accuracy, relevance, and inclusivity of AI systems.Depending on your skills and availability, you may work on text, image, or audio annotation, content evaluation, and prompt creation.Your Arabic language expertise and cultural understanding will help make AI-generated content more natural, reliable, and representative of diverse communities.Projects vary in scope and duration, offering opportunities to gain experience with emerging AI technologies while working on your own terms.This is a talent network opportunity rather than an active job opening, meaning you will be contacted when a suitable project becomes available.Before each project begins, you will receive clear information about the tasks, timeline, and compensation so you can decide whether it fits your interests and availability.
Accountabilities
As a contributor to the AI Trainers Network, you will support projects designed to improve AI performance, language understanding, and content quality. Depending on the project requirements and your areas of expertise, your responsibilities may include:


Annotating and labeling text, images, or audio to help train and improve AI models.


Evaluating search results, advertisements, and chatbot responses for accuracy, relevance, quality, and usefulness.


Creating, testing, and refining prompts to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs).


Reviewing AI-generated content to ensure linguistic accuracy, natural Arabic expression, and cultural appropriateness.


Identifying errors, inconsistencies, and potentially misleading or unsuitable content in AI outputs.


Applying project-specific guidelines and quality standards while maintaining consistency and attention to detail.


Contributing feedback that helps develop safer, more inclusive, and human-centered AI systems.


Managing assigned tasks independently and meeting project deadlines according to agreed requirements and availability.


Requirements
We are looking for detail-oriented, curious, and adaptable contributors who are interested in language, technology, and the development of AI systems. The ideal candidate combines strong Arabic language skills with the ability to evaluate information critically and work independently in a digital environment.


Native or near-native fluency in Arabic, with a strong understanding of grammar, vocabulary, and linguistic nuances.


Current residence in Poland for this opportunity.


Good English proficiency to understand project instructions and communicate effectively.


Comfort using digital tools, online platforms, and web-based applications.


Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify linguistic, factual, and contextual inconsistencies.


Good analytical and critical-thinking skills, particularly when evaluating content for accuracy and relevance.


Cultural awareness and an understanding of Arabic-speaking communities, communication styles, and regional language variations.


Ability to follow detailed guidelines, work independently, and deliver consistent, high-quality results.


Curiosity about artificial intelligence, language technologies, and how human feedback can improve AI systems.


Flexibility to participate in projects of varying durations and complexity, depending on your availability.


Previous experience in data annotation, content evaluation, translation, linguistics, prompt engineering, or AI training may be helpful, but project-specific requirements will vary.
Benefits


Flexible, remote work: Contribute to suitable projects from your preferred working environment, subject to individual project requirements.


Control over your availability: Choose whether to participate when a project matches your schedule and interests.


Project-based opportunities: Access assignments that may last from a few days to several weeks, depending on scope and demand.

Global contributor community: Become part of an international network of people contributing their linguistic and cultural expertise.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in Germany.
As an Account Executive, you will drive business growth across Europe by selling cutting-edge cloud infrastructure technology to enterprise customers, cloud providers, and fast-growing AI and developer platforms. You will own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to technical evaluations, pilot programs, commercial negotiations, and closing deals. Working closely with the founding team and technical experts, you will help customers understand how next-generation microvirtualization can improve workload isolation, security, and infrastructure efficiency. You will build a qualified pipeline through strategic outbound campaigns, industry networking, and targeted account development. As an early sales hire, you will have a direct influence on the go-to-market strategy, sales processes, and future growth of the commercial organization. This fully remote opportunity combines entrepreneurial ownership, technical learning, and uncapped earning potential in a rapidly evolving AI and cloud infrastructure market.
Accountabilities


Build, manage, and grow a European sales pipeline targeting enterprise infrastructure teams, cloud and hosting providers, and high-growth AI and developer technology companies.


Own the full sales cycle, from identifying and qualifying prospects to conducting discovery calls, coordinating technical evaluations, negotiating commercial terms, and securing signed contracts.


Develop and execute targeted outbound strategies in collaboration with go-to-market engineers, identifying priority accounts, key decision-makers, and effective messaging to generate qualified opportunities.


Lead customer conversations and engage economic buyers early, building relationships with CTOs, platform engineering leaders, security teams, procurement professionals, and other stakeholders involved in complex purchasing decisions.


Coordinate product demonstrations, technical deep dives, and proof-of-concept or pilot programs alongside founders and field engineers to demonstrate product value and accelerate customer adoption.


Translate technical capabilities into clear business outcomes, showing customers how lightweight microvirtual machines can improve workload isolation, infrastructure utilization, security, and deployment speed.

title: Service Monteur Warmtepompen
description_clean: De meeste monteurs in Nederland vervangen vandaag nog steeds ketels die er over tien jaar niet meer staan.Ben je loodgieter, servicemonteur of cv-monteur? Bij ons stap je over op de techniek die daarvoor in de plaats komt. Ervaring met warmtepompen hoeft niet, die leren we je. Wat je wel meeneemt is je gevoel voor leidingwerk. Vorig jaar won onze Pomp MP als eerste warmtepomp ooit zowel de iF Design Award Gold als de Red Dot.Elke week gaan er tientallen huizen van het gas af. Het doel is 10% van alle Nederlandse woningen, ongeveer 800.000 huizen. De vraag is er en het product staat. De rem zit op hoe snel we kunnen leveren.Dat lukt niet zonder jou als servicemonteur.WAT JIJ HIER DOETOnderhoud aan onze warmtepompenStoringen oplossen die het serviceteam niet op afstand kon verhelpenInstallaties inspecteren en optimaliserenKlanten uitleggen wat er aan de hand is, in gewone taalTerugkoppelen wat je in het veld ziet, zodat het product beter wordtOngeveer de helft van de storingen zit in onze eigen warmtepomp, waterzijdig of elektrisch. De andere helft zit in de woninginstallatie. Een radiator die niet warm wordt hebben wij niet geplaatst, maar we sturen de klant niet weg. Dat lossen we ook op.WAAROM MONTEURS BIJ ONS BLIJVENGeen storingsdienst. Geen consignatie. Reistijd is werktijd. En jij kiest zelf tussen dertien ADV-dagen of meer salaris per maand.Ons serviceteam op kantoor lost ongeveer negen van de tien meldingen op afstand op en plant jouw week in. Jij rijdt naar de klanten waar echt iemand langs moet. Je krijgt geen telefoon om acht uur ’s avonds.Loop je bij een klant vast, dan bellen onze specialisten in en kijken ze met je mee. Die zitten bij ons in dienst, dus je hebt ze binnen een minuut aan de lijn. Geen half uur in de wacht bij een ketelmerk dat er geen belang bij heeft dat jouw storing vandaag opgelost wordt. Wij hebben hetzelfde doel als jij, dus die stap slaan we over.Zit iemand in het weekend zonder warm water, dan schakelen wij een cv-monteur in en betalen dat zelf. Onze warmtepompboiler heeft bovendien een elektrisch element, dus niemand staat koud.Je werkt zelfstandig vanuit je bus, maar je zit in een serviceteam en hebt korte lijnen met het magazijn en met productontwikkeling.WAT DIT JE OPLEVERTOver twee jaar ken jij deze systemen beter dan bijna iedereen in dit land, simpelweg omdat er nog maar weinig mensen zijn die er dagelijks aan werken. Dat is een positie die je zelf in handen hebt, en die alleen maar meer waard wordt.Daar komt bij: omdat wij het product zelf maken, gaat wat jij in het veld ziet rechtstreeks naar de engineers. Je lost niet alleen storingen op, je zorgt dat ze de volgende keer niet meer voorkomen.WAT JE MEEBRENGTEen paar jaar ervaring als loodgieter, servicemonteur, storingsmonteur, installatiemonteur W, cv-monteur of monteur werktuigbouwkundige installatiesOf een technische mbo-opleiding met de praktijkervaring die daarbij hoort. title: Cyber Security Engineer - Infrastructure & AI Platform Security (w/m/d)
description_clean:

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Sicherheitsarchitektur unserer providerseitigen Infrastrukturschicht und bist Fachexperte (m/w/d) für die intern betriebenen KI-Plattformen und -Agenten. Aufgabenbereich
Infrastruktursicherheit

Definieren und Pflegen von Sicherheitsarchitektur-Standards und Härtungs-Baselines für providerseitige Infrastruktur: Virtualisierungs- und Container-Plattformen, Control Planes und Bereitstellungssysteme, DNS, Mail-Infrastruktur sowie Backup- und Wiederherstellungssysteme.
Bewerten und Stärken der Mandantenisolierung über Shared-Hosting-, Virtualisierungs- und Container-Schichten hinweg sowie Treiben von Behebungsmaßnahmen mit den verantwortlichen Plattform-Teams.
Überprüfen von Infrastruktur-Designs und wesentlichen Änderungen auf Sicherheitsauswirkungen sowie Agieren als Eskalationsinstanz für Fragen zur Infrastruktursicherheit aus Plattform-, Cloud- und Marken-Engineering-Teams.
Reduzieren des Blast Radius auf den wichtigsten Pfaden: privilegierter Zugriff auf kundenorientierte Infrastruktur, administrative Segmentierung, Umgang mit Secrets und Wiederherstellungsintegrität — übersetzt in umsetzbare markenspezifische Implementierungspläne für unsere heterogenen Plattformen.
Unterstützen von Cyber Defense, Vulnerability Management und IT-Notfallmanagement mit Infrastruktur-Expertise bei Vorfällen und der Nachbereitung/Härtung.

Interne KI-Plattform- und Agentensicherheit

Verantwortung für die Sicherheitsarchitektur und Baseline-Standards für die intern betriebenen KI-Plattformen: Modell-Gateways und self-hosted Modelle, Agenten-Frameworks, Assistenten-Integrationen, Konnektoren und Retrieval-Pipelines über interne Daten.
Definieren und Durchsetzen, wie Agenten identifiziert, authentifiziert und autorisiert werden: Umgang mit nicht-menschlichen Identitäten, Credential- und Token-Management, Least-Privilege-Zugriff auf Tools und Systeme sowie Festlegung, wo autonomes Handeln ein Human-in-the-Loop erfordert.
Festlegen, welche Daten interne KI-Systeme aufrufen und indexieren dürfen, sowie Sicherstellen, dass Agentenaktivitäten protokolliert, zuordenbar und überprüfbar sind — entsprechend den Anforderungen unserer regulatorischen Verpflichtungen und Zertifizierungen.
Durchführen von Pre-Deployment-Sicherheitsprüfungen für neue interne KI-Plattformen und Agenten-Anwendungsfälle im Einklang mit dem schnellen Tempo der Adaption sowie Überblicken von ungesicherter/unsanktionierter KI-Nutzung (Shadow AI).
Beraten der Sicherheitsfunktionen und internen Engineering-Teams bei der sicheren Einführung von KI, einschließlich der Schutzplanken (Guardrails), die eine vertretbare Einführung ermöglichen.

Qualifikationen

Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Infrastruktur- oder Plattform-Sicherheit, idealerweise bei einem Hosting-Anbieter, Cloud-Anbieter, Telekommunikationsunternehmen oder in einer vergleichbar großen Mandantenumgebung.
Tiefes praktisches Wissen über Linux, Virtualisierungs- und Container-Plattformen, Netzwerke und die Sicherheitseigenschaften von Mandanten-Infrastrukturen.
Starker Hintergrund im Bereich Identity & Access: Privileged Access, Maschinen- und Workload-Identitäten, Secrets Management, Autorisierungsmodelle und Infrastructure-as-Code-Sicherheit.
Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Durchsetzung von Sicherheitsstandards in einer heterogenen, teils historisch gewachsenen Landschaft sowie bei der Akzeptanzgewinnung in Teams außerhalb der eigenen Führungslinie.
Praktische Kenntnisse im Aufbau und Betrieb von LLM- und Agenten-Systemen sowie der spezifischen Risiken: Prompt Injection durch unvertraute Daten, zu weit gefasste Tool-Zugriffe, Datenexposition durch Retrieval, unprotokolliertes autonomes Handeln, Modell- und Anbieterabhängigkeiten.
Fähigkeit, risikobasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und zu verteidigen — einschließlich des Blockierens von Deployments mit klarer Begründung — sowie technisches Risiko gegenüber nicht-technischen Stakeholdern verständlich zu erklären.
Fließende Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse sind aufgrund unseres regulatorischen Umfelds und des öffentlichen Sektors von starkem Vorteil.

Wünschenswert / Von Vorteil

Wer zu uns passt
Jemand, der sich wohl damit fühlt, bei bestimmten Fragestellungen die/der einzige Expert*in im Raum zu sein, der lieber Ursachen behebt als nur Befunde zu dokumentieren, und der über Sicherheitsfunktionen und Plattform-Teams hinweg agieren kann. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments.This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that.The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup.The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation.You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. title: Senior Data Engineer
description_clean:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

As a Senior Data Engineer on our Maritime Models team, you will take technical ownership of the core data pipelines and distributed storage architectures powering Kpler's vessel tracking and predictive analytics. You will design, scale, and optimize high-throughput batch and streaming pipelines that ingest raw maritime telemetry and transform it into actionable intelligence. Working with distributed NoSQL systems like Apache HBase at scale, your work directly ensures the freshness, accuracy, and reliability of the data models our global customers depend on.

Architect, build, and operate high-throughput batch and streaming data pipelines using Java, Python, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, and Airflow.


Design, tune, and maintain scalable distributed NoSQL databases, prioritizing Apache HBase performance for high-volume time-series maritime telemetry.


Drive end-to-end operational excellence across containerized cloud environments on AWS using Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and GitOps workflows.


Define and enforce system reliability metrics, monitoring pipeline latency, data completeness, and uptime to meet strict operational SLAs.


Partner with Data Scientists, Product Managers, and SRE teams to translate complex maritime modeling requirements into robust, production-grade infrastructure.


Mentor peer engineers, drive code review standards, and leverage modern AI development tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to elevate team productivity.

5+ years of professional experience as a Data Engineer designing, scaling, and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.


Deep, hands-on expertise in distributed NoSQL data stores, specifically Apache HBase, for high-volume time-series storage and query optimization.


Strong proficiency in software engineering using Java and Python.


Demonstrated experience with stream processing and orchestration tools such as Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, and Apache Airflow.


Solid background operating containerized services on AWS cloud environments using Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.


Nice-to-haves


Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.


Experience working with geospatial data technologies (e.g., GeoServer) or spatial indexing algorithms.


Exposure to AI-assisted software development tools like Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code.


Domain familiarity with maritime tracking, AIS telemetry, or supply chain logistics.

Today, we deliver that service through people, software and AI. We’re turning the expertise behind it into autonomous systems that understand situations, take action and follow through. Not another tool to supervise. A service that gets the job done.
We’re looking for an AI Engineer to build the agentic capabilities at the heart of xHeron. You’ll help shape how our agents reason, act and learn, and build a company where AI doesn’t just support the work, but increasingly delivers it.
Tasks
We are looking for an AI Harness Engineer to build the software layer that turns language models into dependable operational systems.
You will work on orchestration, context assembly, tool execution, state, permissions, evaluations, observability, failure recovery, and human handoffs. The goal is not merely to generate a good response.
What You’ll Own

Agent harness architecture: Build the control layer around models: task decomposition, state management, model and tool selection, execution loops, checkpoints, retries, stopping conditions, and human handoffs.
Decision and execution behavior: Design how agents interpret situations, choose actions, manage uncertainty, and complete bounded operational tasks—not only how they generate text.
Context and memory: Determine what an agent needs to know at each step. Build context assembly, retrieval, memory, evidence selection, and knowledge-maintenance strategies while managing relevance, latency, and cost.
Tools and real-world effects: Connect agents to APIs and operational systems through explicit tool contracts, permissions, validation, idempotency, and confirmation that the intended effect actually occurred.
Evaluation and regression testing: Build representative evaluation suites and automated tests for decision quality, tool use, task completion, safety, escalation behavior, and recurring failure patterns.
Observability and failure analysis: Make agent behavior inspectable through structured traces, state, outcomes, and error classification. Diagnose failures across models, prompts, context, tools, and surrounding software.
Continuous improvement: Use evaluations, production traces, operator feedback, and controlled experiments to improve prompts, context, tools, model choices, and agent architecture.
Production ownership: Ship and operate production Python software alongside our CTO and engineering team. Work closely with systems engineering on integrations, authorization, durable state, recovery, and safe execution.

Requirements
What Makes You a Great Fit

You are a strong software engineer who can design, build, test, and operate reliable production systems in Python.
You have built a substantial LLM-powered, automation, workflow, or decision system: not only notebooks, chat interfaces, prompt experiments, or a basic retrieval pipeline.
You understand the engineering layer around a model: orchestration, state, context, tools, structured outputs, permissions, retries, fallbacks, observability, and evaluations.
You can connect intelligence to real work: selecting relevant evidence, making a bounded decision, invoking tools or APIs, and verifying that the intended result occurred.
You design for partial failure and uncertainty. You think deliberately about when an agent should act, retry, wait, stop, ask for help, or escalate.
You evaluate behavior systematically. You use representative cases, traces, outcome checks, comparisons, and regression tests rather than treating a plausible response as proof of success.
You have shipped software that people or operational processes depend on and have worked through debugging, timeouts, inconsistent data, changing APIs, and production incidents.
You can investigate ambiguous problems independently, define a useful system boundary, explain trade-offs clearly, and turn decisions into working software.
You care about simplicity and control. You know when a deterministic workflow is better than an agent and when additional autonomy is justified by evidence.
You bring useful expertise and an independent perspective. Strong adjacent experience in workflow engines, developer tooling, distributed systems, automation platforms, or integration-heavy backend software can be highly relevant when paired with credible LLM-system understanding.

Around 2+ years of professional software-engineering experience is a useful guide, not a hard requirement. What matters is the technical depth of what you built, the decisions and production outcomes you owned, and your ability to learn unfamiliar systems.
You May Not Be a Great Fit If

Your LLM experience is mainly prompt engineering, chatbots, basic RAG, or connecting a model API to a user interface.
Your background is primarily offline data analysis, model training, or experimentation, and you do not want to own production software and operational behavior.
You treat retrieval as the complete agent architecture rather than one possible source of context within a larger execution system.
You consider a coherent model response successful without verifying the decision, tool call, state change, or real-world outcome.
You rely on an agent framework to provide the system design and are not comfortable reasoning about the control flow, state, permissions, and failure behavior underneath it.
You are not interested in owning evaluations, trace analysis, regression testing, and production learning alongside feature development.
You prefer fully scoped implementation tasks with stable requirements and limited responsibility for product or operational outcomes.

Benefits
Real ownership: you're not maintaining someone else's codebase, you're building a core, novel part of the product from the ground up.

Build at the core. Own a defining part of xHeron’s technology, from the first architectural decisions to production.
Shape the direction. Work directly with our CTO, challenge assumptions and help decide what we build, not just how.
Grow beyond the job description. We invest in your development, with room to expand your ownership and take on technical leadership as xHeron grows.
Share in the upside. Salary plus VSOP participation, so you can benefit from the value you help create.

Our Process

Intro call (15-30 min): a conversation with Friedrich (CTO) about your background, what you've built, and why this role.
Technical take-home case study: a short, real engineering problem, close to what you'd actually be building.
Case study interview (1 hour): you walk us through your thinking, not just the final code.
Culture fit (30 min): meet both Founders and make sure it's a fit both ways.

title: (Senior) Accountant/ Buchhalter*in (all genders) in Berlin
description_clean:
We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.
Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Wir entwickeln und betreiben vollständig digitalisierte Serviced Apartments in den großen Städten Deutschlands. Unser nächster Schritt: Europa und darüber hinaus.
Mit dem nanopartment® verfolgen wir eine Produktvision, die modernes Wohnen auf Zeit neu denkt – auf kleinstmöglichem Raum.
Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf.
Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet.
Your Role
Du arbeitest in unserem Finance-Team und verantwortest die korrekte und zuverlässige Buchung der Geschäftsvorfälle unserer Gesellschaften. Gemeinsam mit dem bestehenden Accounting-Team stellst du sicher, dass notwendige Zahlungen in allen Unternehmensbereichen korrekt abgewickelt und verbucht werden. Der Einsatz moderner Software-Lösungen beschleunigt und digitalisiert unsere Prozesse. Du nimmst eine zentrale Rolle im Unternehmen ein und stehst im regelmäßigen Austausch mit den verschiedenen Unternehmensbereichen.  
Diese Position richtet sich an eine Person, die eigenverantwortlich arbeitet, Prozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und gemeinsam mit Homaris langfristig wachsen möchte.
What You'll Do
Geschäftsvorfälle prüfen und buchen. Du stellst sicher, dass sämtliche Geschäftsvorfälle in DATEV korrekt erfasst werden.  
Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung verantworten. Du erfasst die Vorgänge ordnungsgemäß und betreust außerdem die Anlagen- und Bankbuchhaltung.  
Zahlungseingänge und Zahlläufe steuern. Du kontrollierst die Zahlungseingänge und erstellst die erforderlichen Zahlläufe.  
Steuermeldungen übermitteln. Du übermittelst die Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen und Übernachtungssteuererklärungen.  
Konten abstimmen. Du führst Abstimmarbeiten im Sachkonten-, Debitoren- und Kreditorenbereich sowie für Intercompany-Konten durch.  
Abschlüsse vorbereiten. Du übernimmst vorbereitende Tätigkeiten und arbeitest bei der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB mit.  
Kreditkartenabrechnungen bearbeiten. Du bearbeitest und buchst die Kreditkartenabrechnungen über Pleo.  
Prozesse digital weiterentwickeln. Du optimierst proaktiv Prozesse und erhöhst dabei den Digitalisierungsgrad.
What Makes You a Fit
Relevante Ausbildung und Erfahrung. Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung.  
Kenntnisse im deutschen Rechnungswesen. Du verfügst über Kenntnisse des HGB und des Umsatzsteuergesetzes.  
DATEV-Erfahrung. Du bringst Erfahrung mit der Buchhaltungssoftware DATEV mit.Weiterbildung als Pluspunkt. Idealerweise hast du eine Weiterbildung zum/zur geprüften Bilanzbuchhalter:in (IHK) abgeschlossen.  
Digitale Sicherheit. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel, und offen für eine digitale Arbeitsumgebung.  
Eigenständigkeit und Teamgeist. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich, bist zugleich teamfähig und schaust gerne über den eigenen Aufgabenbereich hinaus.  
Verbesserungsorientierung. Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und hast Interesse daran, deinen Bereich aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln.  
Sprachkenntnisse. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B1-Niveau.  
KI-Affinität. Du nutzt digitale Tools mit Leichtigkeit, erkennst ihr Potenzial und bist begeistert davon, wie KI den Arbeitsalltag effizienter gestalten kann.  
Präsenz. Du arbeitest in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu kommen. Du arbeitest gerne persönlich mit anderen zusammen – denn genau so entsteht gute Arbeit.
The Environment
Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.  
Das Tempo ist hoch. Die Herausforderungen sind anspruchsvoll und unmittelbar. Unser Team ist bewusst klein gehalten, sodass jede Person einen spürbaren Beitrag leistet.  
Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt.
What We Offer
Wir definieren unsere Level nicht anhand von Jobtiteln oder Berufsjahren, sondern danach, welche Themen du eigenständig verantwortest und für welche Entscheidungen du einstehst.  
Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. Daraus ist ein Leistungspaket entstanden, das genau das widerspiegelt: Gesundheit, Mobilität, persönliche Entwicklung, Flexibilität und einige besondere Vorteile, die das Arbeiten in der Reise- und Hospitality-Branche mit sich bringt. Vieles ist bereits dabei.  
Die Details stellen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch vor.
Next Steps
Wenn dich diese Position anspricht, freuen wir uns darauf, mehr über deine Erfahrungen und deine Perspektive zu erfahren.  
Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf.  
Wir nehmen uns Zeit, alle Bewerbungen sorgfältig zu prüfen, daher kann es 1-2 Wochen dauern, bis wir uns bei dir zurückmelden. Wir bitten dich um ein wenig Geduld und danken dir dafür!  
Du hast Fragen? Melde dich gerne bei Naomi unter oder +49 1579 2465851
