We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.
This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.
We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.
This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.

À propos de l'opportunité
Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.
En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.
Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.
Vos missions

Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.
Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.
Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.
Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.
Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.
Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.
Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.
Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.
Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons
Indispensable

Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.
Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.
Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.
Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.
La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.
Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.
La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.
Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.
La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.
Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.
Rémunération
Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.
Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.
Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.
Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.
Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.
Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.
Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.
Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.
Formation et accompagnement
Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.
Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.
Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.

You can reason through a difficult question, weigh competing considerations, and recommend a course of action without pretending every answer is certain.You’re an excellent writer and communicator. You can turn complex thinking into clear, precise prose. You enjoy doing the research and developing the argument as much as writing the final piece. You can present well and understand how to communicate what we’re doing to the outside world.You’ve built something and made it better. description_clean:

About FreshaFresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.

Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
 
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
 
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.Role overview
 
Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Associate Account Manager to come and join our global business.
 
Reporting directly to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will be accountable for building relationships and driving monetisation of the Fresha platform.
 
This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact.
 
To foster a collaborative environment that thrives on face-to-face interactions and teamwork, all Fresha employees work from office five days per week in Paris, on the Champs-élysées.Commercial Growth
Engagement - Accountable for meeting key performance indicators on monetisation and revenue growth by proactively engaging with and educating our Partners on the value of the Fresha platform.
Sales Cycle - Proactively introduce, educate and convert Partners on to Fresha’s payments solution.
Market Trends - Optimise listing content and availability competitiveness on the marketplace to maximise conversions.
Relationship Building
Partnering - Have a pool of Partner accounts serving as a dedicated advisor for all your Partners assisting them on their journey to product adoption.
Advisor - Advising Partners on suitable product selection based on their needs and specifications.
Business Partnering - Ensure a strong Partner Experience through building relationships by attending video meetings with your pool of Partners and effectively communicating the Fresha features and benefits.
Relationships - Build key internal relationships with our Sales and Onboarding teams to ensure smooth transition and handover of Partners through the Partner journey.
Collaboration  - Collaborate with our Product teams to provide important product feedback to help enhance future releases.
Persuasion - Use consultative sales techniques to understand customer needs and requirements and have the ability to upsell and cross-sell the Fresha Platform.

 

This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver. 
What we are looking for
Experience - 1-2 Years experience in effectively delivering commercial outcomes from a previous Account Management role
Closing Skills – Demonstrated ability to effectively close deals, negotiate, and convert opportunities
Adaptability - Shown to be commercially motivated with an ability to adapt and achieve targets
Analytics - Proven experience in using and analysing data and reporting effectively to improve commercial outcomes
Curiosity - Naturally proactive and inquisitive, with a desire to consistently learn and improve
Tele-prospecting - Previous experience in an outbound call environment or a related sales position preferred
Communication - Excellent and proven written, verbal and presentation skills
Innovative - Creative thinking and problem-solving mindset
Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder
Team Player - Happy to roll sleeves up and assist the team when required
Initiative - Ability to self-starter with a proactive approach
Added Bonus
Bi-lingual - Fluency in English and another language
Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry

 

At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.
Interview Process
Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins)
Skills & Experience - In-Person interview with Team Leads (30 mins)
Presentation - In-Person interview with General Manager.

 
We aim to complete the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks. 
 

Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe
Inclusive workforce 
 
At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
 
We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
 
We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
 
If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/x)
description_clean:
Your Mission
This is a company built for growth, not comfort.  
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.   
We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.  
Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.  
If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.  
What You’ll Own:

Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.
Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.
Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.
Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.
Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.
Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.
Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.

What Success Looks Like:

You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.
Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.
Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.
Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.
You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.
You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.

What You Bring

Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.
Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.
Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.
Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.
Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.
Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.
Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.
Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.

How We Win

Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/x)
description_clean:
Your Mission
This is a company built for growth, not comfort.  
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.   
We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.  
Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.  
If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.  
What You’ll Own:

Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.
Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.
Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.
Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.
Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.
Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.
Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.

What Success Looks Like:

You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.
Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.
Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.
Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.
You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.
You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.

What You Bring

Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.
Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.
Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.
Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.
Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.
Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.
Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.
Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.

How We Win

Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

title: Platform Security Engineer
description_clean:
At Scality, we build software that stores and protects the world’s most critical data — running on Linux, inside some of the largest infrastructures on the planet, at exabyte scale, for organizations that cannot afford to fail.
We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to join our platform and delivery team in Paris. This is a new seat, and it exists because security work needs dedicated capacity. Absorbed as background tasks between feature tickets, it never gets the focus it deserves. You would be that dedicated capacity.
This is a Linux-first, hands-on engineering role. You will not write policies for other people to implement — you will write the Python and Bash that hardens our OS, automates our vulnerability management, and proves to auditors and customers that our supply chain is sound.

About ScalityScality is the leader in software-defined object storage, trusted by 1,000+ enterprises and 700M+ users worldwide across banking, healthcare, and government sectors — exactly the sectors where security posture is a purchasing criterion, not a checkbox.
Industry recognition:

Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for 9 consecutive years — the only 100% software-defined storage company to hold this position since the quadrant’s inception
#1 on the GigaOm Radar for Enterprise Object Storage (2024), ahead of 17 competing vendors
Gold Stevie Award 2025 — ARTESCA 3.0, Cloud Storage & Backup Solution category
Net Promoter Score of 85 across RING and ARTESCA
About the team
You will join a small team of highly skilled Linux engineers responsible for delivering and maintaining ADI (Scality Autonomous Data Infrastructure), our full platform: RING (object storage), S3C (S3-compatible layer), and SCOS (Scality OS — our own Linux distribution).
The team works across the full stack of infrastructure engineering — deep Linux system integration, RPM packaging, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and release automation. The command line is where most of our day happens, and we ship a Linux distribution to customers.
How We Build
We build with AI tools, in earnest rather than as an experiment. Every engineer here has Claude Code, and it is part of how we write, review, and ship code day to day.
We are also designing something larger: an AI code and delivery factory — AI woven into the build and release chain itself, not just into the editor. That work is early and still being thought through rather than already solved. We expect it to become part of how we maintain the platform, and CVE remediation is one of the first places we think it fits: an automated path from advisory to assessment to a patched, tested, delivered build.
If that sounds like a problem you would want to work on, this role sits close to it.
One principle is not negotiable: a human owns the outcome. AI writes code here, and when it does, we own what it produces — the review, the decision to ship, the consequences, and the fix. “The tool did it” is not an explanation we accept from ourselves, and it is not one we would offer a customer. In security work that matters doubly: an answer you cannot defend is worse than no answer at all.
How This Role Works
Scality is building a network of security engineers across the engineering department — a security peer embedded in each development team, rather than a central security function working at arm’s length from the code. You would be that peer for the platform and delivery team.

Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering. The agenda is set at that level, with dedicated resources committed across the teams. You will not have to invent it alone — and you will have a voice in it: the engineers closest to the code help decide what goes on the roadmap. We will be straight with you: today security work competes with delivery commitments and too often loses. Naming an owner and funding dedicated people is how we intend to change that. You would help build that capability, not inherit a finished one.
The team is accountable for the deliveries. Security items sit on the team’s plate alongside everything else it commits to, rather than in a separate function filing tickets from the outside.
You are the dedicated resource that makes them happen. While your teammates carry releases, OS compatibility, and platform features, your time is reserved for the security work. That focus is the whole reason the seat exists.
You share the team’s perimeter and its knowledge. Same repositories, same Jira projects, same code reviews, same sprint rituals. The engineers around you have rare, hard-earned Linux depth — OS integration, RPM packaging, boot and GRUB, CI/CD, monitoring — and you will learn the platform from them.
You will have peers. Security engineers embedded in the other development teams work the same problems on different perimeters. That network is where you compare notes, share tooling, and grow into the craft.

The point of the model is that security decisions get made inside the team that builds and ships the product, by someone who understands the build system rather than filing tickets against it.
Your First Missions
Two priorities are already on the roadmap, and they will shape your first year.
1. CVE exposure, answered before it is asked
Customers in banking, healthcare, and government ask us, routinely and under their own audit obligations, whether our products are exposed to a given CVE. That will not stop — for them, asking is the compliance requirement. Today each answer is researched from scratch: a customer question becomes a ticket, the ticket becomes a hunt through SBOMs, vendor advisories, and our own configuration, and the round trip can take weeks to produce something the team is not fully confident defending.
Your first mission is to invert that, so the answer already exists when the question arrives.

A standing exposure record, per shipped component and per release: what the SBOM says is present, what the upstream vendor has decided (including “will not fix”, which is common on RHEL 8 and often the real answer), and whether the vulnerable code path is actually reachable in our configuration
Reachability over presence. A module shipped and loaded by a distribution default is not the same as a module configured on a live URL. That distinction is the difference between “vulnerable” and “no impact”, and it is where the engineering judgement lives
Continuous CVE detection across our repositories, vendored third-party modules, container images, and shipped RPMs
Wiring detection into our existing SBOM tooling and GitHub Actions pipelines, so exposure is computed when a release is built rather than when a customer asks
A defined interface with the security engineers and the customer-facing teams: who produces the technical assessment, who owns the wording that reaches the customer, and how both meet the response commitments in our customer security policy
Durable capture. An assessment that lives only in a ticket comment gets re-derived next release. Findings belong somewhere queryable
A remediation loop with clear ownership and response targets, integrated with how the team already works in Jira
AI-assisted remediation, where it fits: from advisory to proposed patch to a tested build, with a human deciding what ships

Done well, a customer’s “are you affected by X?” becomes a lookup and an afternoon, not an escalation and three weeks.
2. Raising the security baseline of SCOS
SCOS is our own Linux distribution — we control the kickstarts, the package set, the boot path, and the images. That is unusual leverage, and we intend to use it. You will drive platform-level hardening across the OS we ship:

A hardened, defensible default configuration for the distribution
Advancing SELinux enforcement across RING and S3C (work already begun on the team, which you will help carry)
Supply-chain integrity: artifact provenance, signing, dependency currency, reproducible and verifiable builds
Secrets and credential handling across the delivery pipeline
Cryptographic posture — including FIPS 140-3 readiness, which matters concretely: FIPS 140-2 certificates move to NIST’s historical list on 22 September 2026, and RHEL 9’s validated OpenSSL, GnuTLS, and kernel crypto modules are the foundation we build on
Compliance-driven engineering work, notably the supply-chain security expectations of NIS2 (Article 21(2)(d)) and the EU Cyber Resilience Act — translated into automation and evidence, not spreadsheets

You will also contribute to what comes next: threat modelling of the platform, hardening guidance for customers, and security review of significant design changes.
What We Are Looking For
This is a role for someone early in their career who wants to grow into being their team’s security reference. We expect to invest in you, and we expect you to keep growing here for as long as you want to — there is no ceiling built into this seat.
Required

Linux is your primary operating system — at work, at home, or both. You are comfortable in the terminal and you reach for a shell before a UI
Roughly 2–4 years of relevant experience, or a shorter track record with unusually strong evidence of the skills below
Solid working ability in Python and Bash — you will be writing and maintaining real code in a production codebase
A genuine, demonstrable interest in security. We care much more about this than about formal credentials. Show it however it is true for you: CTFs, a home lab, reading advisories and CVE writeups for fun, a hardening project, security-adjacent contributions, a blog, anything real
Comfortable using Git in a collaborative environment
Ability to read and understand existing code before modifying it
The judgement to tell a real risk from a scanner’s opinion — and the instinct to check whether vulnerable code is actually reachable before calling it exposed
The willingness to say plainly when you are not yet sure, rather than producing an answer you could not defend
French — the team works in French day to day
Written communication skills in English

Nice to Have

CVE triage, CVSS scoring, or vulnerability management experience
Reading vendor advisories and understanding vendor triage — NVD, RHSA, Red Hat severity and will-not-fix calls
Supply-chain security tooling — SBOM formats (SPDX, CycloneDX), scanners (Trivy, Grype, Syft), artifact signing
RPM packaging or Linux distribution internals
SELinux policy work
CI/CD systems, especially GitHub Actions
RHEL / Rocky Linux (versions 8 and 9)
Containers (Docker, containerd, systemd units)
Ansible or Salt
Awareness of NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, or FIPS 140-3
Familiarity with S3 or object storage concepts
Serious use of AI coding tools in a real workflow — Claude Code or equivalent, beyond autocomplete

To Be Clear About Scope
This is a software engineering role with a security mandate. It is not a SOC or incident-response analyst position, not a penetration-testing role, and not a GRC or compliance-documentation role. If what you want is to build the tooling and harden the system yourself, in code, you are in the right place.
What We Offer

Dedicated focus. Security is your job here, not the thing you get to after the sprint work is done
Clear direction, and a say in it. Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering, and the team is accountable for delivering them. You would not be inventing the agenda on your own, you would help shape what goes on it, and you would be part of making it stick
A network of peers. Security engineers embedded in the other development teams, working the same problems on different perimeters
Work that compounds. Customer security questions are a permanent obligation, so every assessment you make reusable and every check you automate keeps paying back, release after release
Modern tooling, actually adopted. Claude Code in every engineer’s hands, and a real say in how AI reshapes our build and delivery chain
A rare combination: security work with the leverage of owning the whole stack, down to our own Linux distribution
Mentorship from senior engineers with deep expertise across Linux, storage, packaging, and distributed systems — you will not be the only person who understands your perimeter
A long-term growth path toward becoming your team’s security reference and a senior voice in the network
Work that ships to production and runs at exabyte scale, in banking, healthcare, and government
Standard French benefits: meal vouchers, Navigo subsidy, mutuelle

title: Alternant·e Growth Marketing Manager | Thiga Academy
description_clean:
Alternance · Paris 9e · Télétravail · rythme d’alternance souhaité 3 semaines entreprise / 1 semaine école 
 
Thiga en 30 secondes : 
Thiga est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en IA et en digital. Nous accompagnons les plus grands groupes et scale-ups françaises : Decathlon, Doctolib, AXA, ManoMano, Mirakl, Disney, Leboncoin et une centaine d'autres. En inter-entreprise comme en intra, on transmet ce que nos consultants pratiquent chez nos clients tous les jours
 
Pourquoi ce poste : 

L'Academy forme chaque année 2000 professionnels et son offre est solide. Le problème : aujourd'hui, elle ne communique presque pas. Peu de contenu, peu de présence, une notoriété très en dessous de ce que le catalogue mérite.
C'est une page blanche côté growth, et c'est exactement ce qui rend le poste intéressant. On cherche quelqu'un pour construire, mesurer et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition de l'Academy à partir de zéro : quels canaux, quels messages, quel funnel, avec quels résultats. Pas pour décorer le catalogue, pour le remplir.
Ce que tu vas faire 🖇
1. Construire et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition, avec le Head of Marketing & Events


Structurer le tunnel d'acquisition de bout en bout : quels canaux amènent du trafic, ce qui convertit en lead, ce qui déclenche l'inscription


Tester des canaux et des formats en continu (LinkedIn organique et payant, email, SEO, partenariats, salons) et couper vite ce qui ne marche pas


Créer et itérer les landing pages du catalogue et des sessions, pensées pour convertir dès le premier jet et retravaillées à partir de la donnée


Mettre en place les séquences email dans HubSpot : nurturing, relances, réactivation des contacts dormants, avec un test A/B sur les objets et les CTA


Accompagner le lancement des nouvelles formations avec un plan d'acquisition dédié, pas seulement un plan de com


Créer les supports nécessaires au tunnel avec Figma (catalogue, plaquettes, brochures) en gardant en tête qu'un support existe pour convertir, pas pour exister


Représenter l'Academy sur des salons et événements, avec un objectif de leads qualifiés en sortie, pas juste de présence


2. Mesurer, analyser, arbitrer
Le nerf du poste. Sans mesure, pas de growth, juste du marketing qui se raconte des histoires.


Suivre les KPIs qui comptent à chaque étape du tunnel : trafic, taux de clic, taux de conversion en lead, taux de conversion en inscrit, coût d'acquisition par inscrit, taux de remplissage des sessions


Construire les dashboards HubSpot qui donnent une vision claire de ce qui marche, canal par canal, campagne par campagne


Identifier où le tunnel fuit et proposer les hypothèses à tester pour colmater


Faire remonter les résultats au Head of Marketing & Events pour arbitrer les prochains messages, offres et canaux, avec des chiffres, pas des impressions


3. Faire vivre la marque et la communauté qui nourrissent le funnel
L'acquisition ne marche pas sans contenu ni preuve sociale. C'est le carburant du tunnel.


Poser la ligne éditoriale et la faire vivre : posts LinkedIn, articles, newsletters, formats courts autour du product et de l'IA


Animer la relation avec les alumni et la communauté d'apprenants : témoignages, cas concrets, un bouche-à-oreille qu'on peut transformer en canal d'acquisition mesurable


L'IA n'est pas une option chez nous, c'est la pierre angulaire de notre façon de travailler, et on attend de toi que tu aies cette fibre. Concrètement, tu t'appuieras sur l'IA à chaque étape : générer et itérer des variantes de copies avec Claude, produire des visuels avec Nano Banana et Figma, des teasers avec HeyGen, ou transformer une transcription Granola en article et en carrousel LinkedIn. C'est ce qui te permet d'avancer vite et de tester dix fois plus d'hypothèses qu'une équipe classique.
La stack que tu vas pratiquer 🧰
Le growth marketing moderne, c'est une combinaison d'intuition testée par la donnée, de vitesse d'exécution et de bons outils au bon moment.


LLM et agents : Claude (Pro et Code), Gemini


Génération visuelle et audio : Nano Banana, Adobe Firefly, ElevenLabs, HeyGen


Marketing ops : HubSpot (CRM, marketing hub, workflows), Luma, Phantom Buster


Prise de notes et capitalisation : Granola, Notion AI


Vibe coding (en bonus, pour les profils qui veulent aller plus loin) : Lovable, Cursor pour bricoler des micro-outils internes


Tu n'as pas besoin de tout maîtriser à l'arrivée. On attend une vraie curiosité et l'envie de pratiquer, pas un CV exhaustif.
Le profil que nous recherchons 🌟


Formation : école de commerce ou de communication, en M1 ou M2, idéalement avec une spécialisation marketing, growth ou entrepreneuriat


Pratique IA personnelle prouvée : tu as un side project, un compte ChatGPT ou Claude que tu utilises tous les jours, un workflow Make ou n8n que tu as construit, un agent custom, un blog assisté par LLM, un repo GitHub, ou n'importe quoi qui démontre que l'IA est dans ta vie.


Réflexe growth : tu penses en funnel avant de penser en campagne, tu formules des hypothèses avant de produire, et tester puis mesurer te vient plus naturellement que produire pour produire


Appétence data : Excel ou Google Sheets n'ont pas de secret pour toi, et l'idée de creuser un dashboard pour comprendre pourquoi un taux de conversion a bougé t'intéresse plus qu'elle ne t'ennuie


Fibre communication : tu sais écrire pour être lu, tu as déjà animé une page, un compte ou une communauté


Rigueur opérationnelle et sens du détail : tu sais qu'une séquence email qui commence par « Bonjour {prénom} », ça fait tâche, et qu'un A/B test mal cadré ne prouve rien


Sensibilité business : tu comprends les concepts MQL, CAC, NPS, et tu sais qu'une belle campagne ne vaut rien si elle ne remplit pas les sessions


Au-delà des hard skills, on recherche surtout quelqu’un de curieux, volontaire, débrouillard et qui n’a pas peur de proposer des nouvelles idées !

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description_clean:
About AQEMIA
 
AQEMIA is a drug invention company dedicated to creating entirely new medicines to address major unmet medical needs. At the core of our mission is QEMI, our proprietary molecule-invention platform, which uniquely combines cutting-edge science with advanced technology. Powered by physics-based modeling, statistical mechanics, and generative AI, QEMI allows our teams to design novel drug candidates from first principles.
 
What makes AQEMIA different is our commitment to true innovation: our research is dedicated to the invention of new molecular entities, not the refinement of existing ones. We focus on inventing never-before-seen molecules, without relying on experimental data, and advancing them into a growing pipeline of proprietary programs and strategic partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies.
 
Our most advanced preclinical programs are currently in vivo optimization, targeting diseases still waiting for effective treatments, offering our teams the opportunity to work on science that can make a real difference in people’s lives.
 
For more information, visit AQEMIA.com, our WTTJ Page, and our LinkedIn. 
 
About our Team
 
AQEMIA brings together a diverse, multidisciplinary team of 80+ professionals based in Paris and London. Our scientists and engineers, including chemists, physicists, machine learning experts, and software engineers, work side by side to push the boundaries of early-stage drug discovery.
 
This close collaboration across disciplines is central to our approach, enabling us to tackle complex scientific challenges from first principles and translate cutting-edge ideas into novel therapeutic candidates. At AQEMIA, team members are encouraged to contribute their expertise, learn from one another, and play an active role in shaping the future of drug invention.
The role
AQEMIA's drug discovery programs and AI platform increasingly create value through licensing deals and strategic partnerships with pharma and biotech companies.
As our first in-house Legal Counsel, you will lead the legal work on these deals from term sheet to signing. You'll make sure each licensing agreement maximises value creation for Aqemia, protects our IP, and the platform behind every program. Beyond licensing, you will become the trusted legal partner for CEO, founders, leadership and teams across the company, covering IP and patents, operational contracts, data and AI, compliance and corporate matters alongside specialist external counsel. Within a year, you will have shaped how legal works at AQEMIA: issues will be mapped and anticipated, processes will be practical, and leadership will rely on you for well-judged legal advice. Reporting to the Corporate Finance Manager, you’ll have a rare chance to sit at the centre of the deals that bring AI-discovered drug candidates to partners, and to grow well beyond licensing into a broad in-house role.
Responsibilities

Licensing & partnerships: lead the legal work on licensing and collaboration deals, drafting and negotiating agreements from term sheet to signing.
Deal strategy: work with BD, Finance and Leadership to turn commercial goals into contract terms, while protecting AQEMIA's platform and other programs.
IP & patents: support IP protection and patent-related decisions with scientific teams and external patent counsel.
Operational contracts: draft and negotiate NDAs, MTAs, CRO, vendor, software and data agreements, including contractual questions on data use and AI.
Corporate & compliance: adresss GDPR, regulatory, compliance and dispute-related matters with specialist support where needed, and support corporate and fundraising matters in coordination with Finance and external advisors.
Legal processes: own templates and approval workflows, highlight key contract obligations and deadlines to relevant teams, and manage external counsel.

Qualifications

Law degree or equivalent professional legal qualification.
5+ years of legal experience, including time at a law firm in a life sciences practice. In-house experience at a biotech or pharma company is a strong plus.

title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description_clean:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Netherlands.
Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.
Accountabilities

Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

Requirements

Education: A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable.
Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, instrumentation, spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical method development.
Research or laboratory experience: Experience in laboratory-based research, analytical method validation, pharmaceutical or environmental testing, instrumentation-intensive studies, or related scientific applications is highly desirable.
Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures.
Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning.
Written communication: Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly, precisely, and logically.
Analytical thinking: Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and document reproducible findings.
AI training readiness: Interest in evaluating AI-generated content, identifying model limitations, and contributing to the development of more reliable scientific AI systems.
Working arrangements: Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment, manage assignments effectively, and provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

Benefits

Competitive hourly compensation: A pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the final rate determined by expertise, professional experience, and geographic location. The final offer may vary from the advertised range.
Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility associated with a freelance contract arrangement.
Meaningful scientific impact: Help shape AI systems that may support scientific education, research, analytical problem-solving, and laboratory workflows.
Intellectually stimulating work: Apply advanced analytical chemistry knowledge to challenging scientific questions and emerging AI evaluation tasks.
Specialized professional contribution: Use your research, instrumentation, and laboratory expertise in an innovative technology-focused environment.
Independent contractor arrangement: Manage your work in a freelance capacity, subject to project requirements and applicable engagement terms.

Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards


Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

title: Scrum Master / Delivery Enabler (m/w/d) - KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung
description_clean: Du begeisterst dich für agile Delivery und willst die sich wandelnde Rolle des Scrum Masters im KI-Zeitalter aktiv mitgestalten? Und, du bist an vielfältigen Projekten in einem kollegialen Arbeitsumfeld interessiert? Dann schau dir MaibornWolff einmal näher an! Wir bei MaibornWolff sind ein inhabergeführtes, mittelständisches IT-Beratungsunternehmen mit über 30 Jahren Expertise. Mit rund 800 Tech-begeisterten Menschen beraten wir unsere Kunden bei ihren Digitalisierungsstrategien und entwickeln moderne, individuelle Softwarelösungen. 2024 sind wir in die Lünendonk-Liste der „führenden mittelständischen IT-Beratungen in Deutschland" aufgestiegen, worauf wir sehr stolz sind.In unserer Delivery-Enabler Gilde arbeiten aktuell elf Scrum Master:innen, Agile Coaches und Delivery Enabler an mehreren Standorten in Deutschland. Unsere Mission: Delivery Enablement als starke, zukunftsfähige Rolle etablieren und Projekt-Teams auch im KI-Wandel wirksam unterstützen. Wir teilen Wissen, gestalten unsere Rolle gemeinsam weiter und bringen unterschiedliche Stärken ein. Unsere Projekte reichen von einzelnen Entwicklungsteams bis hin zu internationalen Programmen in Branchen wie Automotive, Energie und Public Sector.Hier kommst du ins Spiel: Als Delivery Enabler übernimmst du Verantwortung für eine Rolle im Umbruch, führst interdisziplinäre Teams durch den KI-Wandel und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, Delivery Enablement zu einer starken, zukunftsfähigen Funktion weiterzuentwickeln.Deine AufgabenTeams stärken: Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Entwicklungsteams zusammen: Du beseitigst Hindernisse, entwickelst konstruktive Arbeitsweisen weiter und förderst so effektive Teamstrukturen.Stakeholder steuern: Du bringst die unterschiedlichen Interessen von Team, Kunde und MaibornWolff aktiv zusammen und sorgst so für einen klaren, effizienten Entscheidungs- und Kommunikationsfluss.Delivery absichern: Anhand konkreter Kennzahlen machst du Wirkung und Wertbeitrag deiner Rolle sichtbar. Und, du bist an vielfältigen Projekten in einem kollegialen Arbeitsumfeld interessiert? Dann schau dir MaibornWolff einmal näher an! Wir bei MaibornWolff sind ein inhabergeführtes, mittelständisches IT-Beratungsunternehmen mit über 30 Jahren Expertise. Wenn du möchtest, engagierst du dich zusätzlich als Mentor:in in der Mitarbeitendenentwicklung oder in anderen internen Aufgaben.Dein ProfilAusbildung: Du hast idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft oder IT - entscheidend ist für uns jedoch deine reale Projekterfahrung.Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3-5 Jahre relevante Projekterfahrung als Scrum Master, Agile Coach oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle innerhalb der Softwareentwicklung mit. Du kennst sowohl die Arbeit auf Teamebene als auch die Koordination über mehrere Teams hinweg, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung in interkulturellen Kontexten.Methodenkompetenz: Du beherrschst agile Frameworks wie Scrum oder Kanban und bestenfalls auch Skalierungsmodelle wie SAFe, Nexus oder LeSS. Zudem bist du stark in Stakeholder-Management, Facilitation & Workshop-Design sowie in agilen Metriken und Forecasting. Vielleicht hast du sogar bereits Erfahrungen mit OKRs, Flight Levels oder im Value Stream Mapping gesammelt. Tools: Du nutzt KI-Anwendungen routiniert und zielgerichtet für deine eigene Arbeitseffizienz. description_clean:

Die Gruppe ist ein zukunftssicherer Technologieanbieter mit einer langjährigen Erfolgsbilanz in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche und einem konsolidierten Umsatz von über 100 Millionen Euro. Die Gruppe gehört zu den 100 weltweit führenden Fintech-Anbietern (IDC-Ranking) und zählt mehr als 200 führende Vermögensverwalter, Banken, Asset Manager, Fondsmanager, Versicherer und Outsourcer in über 15 Ländern zu ihren Kunden. Mitwirkung und Mitgestaltung bei Aufbau, Produktivnahme und Betrieb eines Systems
Monitoring, Deployment und Stagemanagement eines Systems
Aufbau von Wissen durch den Einsatz in verschiedenen Fachabteilungen
Selbstständige Fehleranalyse und -behebung durch geeignete Tools
Ansprechpartner bei Problemen des Systems
Erstellung/Erweiterung technischer Dokumentationen
Implementierung und Erweiterung von Betriebsautomation

Mittlerer Bildungsabschluss oder Abitur/Fachabitur, gerne auch Studienabbrecher
Großes Interesse an IT und Softwareentwicklung
Erste Kenntnisse im Bereich Programmierung sind wünschenswert
Logische und strukturierte Denkweise
Lernbereitschaft und eine gute Auffassungsgabe
Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Zuverlässigkeit und eine offene Art
Fließendes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift und gute Englischkenntnisse

Professionelle Ausbildung mit einer umfangreichen Betreuung durch unsere Ausbilder

Enterprise Account Executive, Energy & Utilities
Enterprise Account Executive - CEE
Senior Solution Engineer
Junior Frontend Developer (React)
Strategic Project Manager
description_clean: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. LocationThis is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.Your MissionYou get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.As a Senior Project Manager, you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.Your Career Path in Project ManagementThis is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. description_clean:

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.
Accountabilities

Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

Requirements

Education: A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable.
Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, instrumentation, spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical method development.
Research or laboratory experience: Experience in laboratory-based research, analytical method validation, pharmaceutical or environmental testing, instrumentation-intensive studies, or related scientific applications is highly desirable.
Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures.
Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning.
Written communication: Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly, precisely, and logically.
Analytical thinking: Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and document reproducible findings.
AI training readiness: Interest in evaluating AI-generated content, identifying model limitations, and contributing to the development of more reliable scientific AI systems.
Working arrangements: Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment, manage assignments effectively, and provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

Benefits

Competitive hourly compensation: A pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the final rate determined by expertise, professional experience, and geographic location. The final offer may vary from the advertised range.
Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility associated with a freelance contract arrangement.

title: Co-Founder & CTO @ AI Model Efficiency Engine Venture, Berlin
description_clean: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.About the VentureAI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. Think ten specialists working on ten pieces, rather than one generalist carrying the whole task.Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.Our founder was selected for Slush 20 Under 20, awarded by Anthropic, Slush, Index Ventures and Sifted, and brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. We closed our pre-seed round in two weeks. With people already waiting to use the product, we are looking for a technical co-founder to help shape what comes next and bring it into production.About the RoleAs co-founder and CTO, you will help shape the company as well as its technology. Working alongside the founder as an eye-level partner, you will turn the ambition into an architecture, a product and an engineering team capable of delivering it.aYour remit spans the efficiency engine, the platform beneath it and the people building both. You will lead our founding AI engineer and backend platform engineer, grow the team and establish the standards that guide its work. You have led engineering before, but stayed close to the code, and want to keep building as your responsibilities grow.Two things define the technical challenge here. Efficiency is the product itself, so routing, fine-tuning, caching, quantization and open-weight serving sit at the heart of the roadmap. Agentic engineering is also central to how we work. You will set the standard for using individual agents and entire agent fleets effectively, building the harnesses and workflows that allow a small team to move quickly while retaining sound engineering judgement.There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with relentless intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and look for people who take initiative and see things through. You will have the scope to make consequential decisions early, and the responsibility to turn them into something that works.What you’ll doYou will move between architecture, code and company building, setting the technical direction while building the team that delivers it.Lead the engineering team: guide our founding AI engineer and backend platform engineer, review their work and establish the engineering and operational standards, including on-call and incident response.Build the team: lead technical hiring and decide how engineering grows as the company develops.Set the technical direction: make the architectural calls, shape the roadmap and decide what we build ourselves and where we use existing tools and services.Develop the efficiency engine: bring together routing, semantic and prefix caching, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, distillation, quantization and batching, with inference economics informing each decision.Own open-weight serving: choose and operate vLLM, SGLang or equivalent, including GPU capacity and European hosting, alongside closed providers through a single interface.Make quality measurable: build rigorous eval harnesses and the evidence needed to establish whether a cheaper route still meets the agreed standard.Build the platform underneath it: own the gateway API, provider layer, identity and tenancy, precise usage and cost accounting, secure storage of customer keys and European infrastructure as code, with GDPR and data residency requirements built in.Stay hands-on: write code and play an active part in designing and building the platform and cost-efficiency systems. Develop our agentic engineering setup, from harness design and benchmarking to the agent workflows that help the team ship.Represent the company technically: bring depth and clarity to customer pilots, enterprise security reviews and investor conversations.About YouYou have grown into engineering leadership without losing the instinct to build. When faced with a difficult problem, you explore what would make it possible and look for a workable path through it, weighing failure modes alongside unit economics. AI has changed how you work, and you have taken the time to understand where it helps, where it fails and how to use it well.We are looking for depth in five areas:Engineering leadership: you have been a CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering or engineering lead, ideally in a startup. You have hired and led engineers, established standards and taken responsibility for both the architecture and what the team shipped.Backend and platform engineering: you bring deep experience in distributed systems, API design, streaming, Postgres, Kubernetes, Terraform and cloud operations, with a broad understanding of what makes a platform reliable and scalable. You have taken systems into production, operated them under significant load and worked through incidents yourself.LLM cost efficiency: you have reduced costs in a production system and can explain the numbers, the decisions behind them and the trade-offs involved. Your experience covers techniques such as LoRA or QLoRA, routing, caching, quantization, distillation and batching, grounded in an understanding of serving economics.Open-weight models in production: you have served, tuned, evaluated and operated open models under load, including the GPU and capacity decisions that come with them.Agentic engineering: you build on strong coding fundamentals, with practical experience running agent fleets and designing and benchmarking their harnesses. You can reason independently about the code they produce and take responsibility for its quality.You also bring a disciplined approach to LLM benchmarking: thoughtful eval design, statistical honesty and a willingness to reproduce results before relying on them.Fluent English is required; German is a plus.Nice to haveA strong open-source record, particularly in AI infrastructure or inference, with real users.Experience with LiteLLM, NVIDIA NIM, TGI, llama.cpp or similar, and with self-hosted or air-gapped enterprise deployments.Experience with European cloud providers such as Scaleway, Hetzner or OVH.Experience working in startups tackling similar technical challenges.Why JoinWith the pre-seed round closed and the first steps already taken, you will join at a point where there is momentum to build on and considerable room to shape what comes next. You will build alongside the founder, choose and grow the engineering team, and receive co-founder equity in the business you help create.The architecture, efficiency engine, security model and engineering culture are all still yours to shape. The decisions you make now will become the foundations for everything that follows.We are entering a market where competitors have larger teams, more funding and an earlier start. Our conviction is that technical depth, focused decisions and a small team that works well together give us a meaningful opportunity to compete. For the right person, that is an interesting challenge to take on, with substantial ownership over how we approach it.This is a full-time commitment, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible.
