title: Senior Frontend Engineer - London
description_clean: About UsPerk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.Visit www.perk.com to learn more.What you'll do:You'll own building the experiences of our group travel and events product, an all-in-one platform helping companies book providers and coordinate their attendees. This is a complex, multi-sided offering spanning corporate event planners, event support specialists on the Perk side, suppliers and event participants. You'll be the design lead shaping how those experiences come together in the product and within the broader Perk platform (travel, spend).At Perk, we believe that real-life connections have greater value than ever. While the world has embraced hybrid work, the need for teams to gather, brainstorm, and celebrate in person has skyrocketed. That’s why we built Perk Events.Born from our internal innovation incubator, Perk Events is our newest vertical. We are moving from "start-up" to "scale-up," and we are looking for a Senior Front End Engineer. This isn't just an ordinary Engineering role; it’s an opportunity to disrupt a legacy industry with AI-driven tech, and lead a world-class team driving towards ambitious revenue goals.You'll own building the experiences of our group travel and events product, an all-in-one platform helping companies book providers and coordinate their attendees. This is a complex, multi-sided offering spanning corporate event planners, event support specialists on the Perk side, suppliers and event participants. You'll be the design lead shaping how those experiences come together in the product and within the broader Perk platform (travel, spend).Some examples of what it means to be a Senior at PerkShape the bigger picture. You won't just build features, you'll refine the what to build and why. At Perk, senior engineers are expected to go beyond the technical solution and focus on the problem itself. You'll contribute to your squad's quarterly goals and long-term vision alongside your Product Manager and Engineering Manager.Architect for today and tomorrow. When a big change is needed in how our platform works, you'll be the one writing the design documents that lay the foundation. You'll become a guardian of your team's technical quality; spotting areas of investment, proactively managing technical debt, and making sure we don't let "busy work" crowd out the work that truly matters. At Perk, we believe in impact over effort: our customers see results, not the hours behind them. Your job is to make sure we're always investing our energy where it counts most.Lead across boundaries. Your influence won't stop at your own squad. You'll communicate complex ideas across multiple teams, proactively identify who needs to be involved, and drive alignment across the broader organisation. Whether it's coordinating a cross-squad initiative, contributing to one of our engineering guilds (where engineers from different teams align on shared technical topics), or pairing with architects on solution discovery, you'll operate comfortably beyond your immediate team.Raise the bar for everyone around you. Senior engineers at Perk are mentors, coaches, and bar raisers. You'll support less experienced colleagues through direct mentorship, thoughtful feedback during reviews, and by modelling what great engineering looks like in practice. You'll help Engineering Managers understand where the team needs to grow technically, and you'll use spaces like guild meetings, design doc reviews, and pairing sessions to lift the overall standard. At Perk, we are a team, the team's success is your success.AI at PerkAI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.How We WorkAt Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.Protect Yourself from Recruitment ScamsAll official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. AQEMIA brings together a diverse, multidisciplinary team of 80+ professionals based in Paris and London. Our scientists and engineers, including chemists, physicists, machine learning experts, and software engineers, work side by side to push the boundaries of early-stage drug discovery.
 
This close collaboration across disciplines is central to our approach, enabling us to tackle complex scientific challenges from first principles and translate cutting-edge ideas into novel therapeutic candidates. At AQEMIA, team members are encouraged to contribute their expertise, learn from one another, and play an active role in shaping the future of drug invention.
 
About our Engineering Department

The Engineering team (~12 people) builds and scales the technical foundations that power Aqemia’s drug discovery engine.
 
Bringing together expertise across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), and scientific computing, the team designs and operates robust, secure, and high-performance platforms that enable Aqemia’s scientific and AI teams to experiment, train, deploy, and run models at scale.
 
Their work spans data infrastructure, scientific compute systems, cloud operations, orchestration, observability, CI/CD, developer tooling, and platform scalability. By transforming cutting-edge research into reliable and scalable systems, the team accelerates the discovery of new medicines while ensuring operational excellence and an outstanding developer experience.
The role

As our Senior Data Engineer, you'll own AQEMIA's data platform end to end — from ingestion through the pipeline to the trusted, model-ready datasets that power science, ML and analytics. What makes this role distinctive is the data itself: chemical structures, molecular conformations, physics- and ML-based predictions, and experimental results from CROs and partners.
A core part of the work is modelling these scientific entities well — establishing canonical identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous, often messy sources — so scientists, and increasingly AI agents, can rely on them. You'll work at the intersection of software engineering, data infrastructure and scientific research, with real scope to shape architecture rather than just execute against it.
As AQEMIA moves toward more service and API-driven integration next year, you'll help make data fit for automation — expanding your impact from pipelines to the systems that consume them.
Responsibilities

Own AQEMIA's Bronze → Silver → Gold data pipelines end to end, from ingestion through transformation and delivery, maintaining lineage and traceability as data volume and complexity grow.
Model canonical scientific entities — compounds, structures, assays, predictions — establishing identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous and often messy sources.
Set and uphold data quality standards through monitoring, validation, testing and alerting across critical pipelines, strengthening governance and observability so datasets stay trusted and accessible.
Partner with ML engineers, data scientists and researchers to build curated, model-ready datasets, translating scientific and business requirements into scalable data solutions.
Drive data architecture and engineering best practices — data modeling, testing, documentation, orchestration and deployment — in collaboration with the Engineering Manager and Staff Data Engineer on roadmap execution.
Build self-service capabilities and, looking ahead, APIs that make data fit for automation as AQEMIA moves toward more service-based integration.
Uphold engineering quality through code reviews, and mentor junior engineers by sharing knowledge and best practices as a senior individual contributor.

Qualifications

Deep experience in data engineering, with a track record of production systems that other teams depend on. We care about what you have built, not the year count. 
Strong software engineering skills. You code, you review code, and you hold a quality bar.
Expert in Python and SQL. - Strong data modelling and relational database experience. You can defend an identity key.
Production experience with a cloud warehouse (we use Snowflake) and a transformation framework (we use dbt).
Experience with workflow orchestration (we use Airflow) and infrastructure-as-code (we use Terraform on AWS).
Any STEM degree or equivalent experience.

Nice-to-have

Experience with AWS.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and modern data warehousing (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and object storage.
Experience in drug discovery, biotech, pharma or deeptech environments.
Exposure to AI-driven or data-intensive workflows, or experience working across disciplines (e.g. biology ↔ ML ↔ chemistry).
Experience implementing data governance, lineage and metadata management solutions.
Track record of improving platform scalability, reliability and operational maturity.

Our recruitment process

950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA.

En tant qu'Expert & Trainer GenAI, tu t'inscris à la croisée de l'ingénierie logicielle, de la formation d'élite et du conseil stratégique. Tu es le garant de la mise en œuvre pragmatique et sécurisée de l'IA chez nos clients.

Tu concois, pilotes et déploies des architectures GenAI robustes et prêtes pour la production :


Model Engineering & Contexte : Arbitrage et choix des LLMs (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Open Source), optimisation des paramètres (fenêtre de contexte, context caching, system prompts) et maîtrise du Model Context Protocol (MCP).


Pipelines Avancés & RAG : Conception de stratégies de retrieval complexes (chunking, bases vectorielles, GraphRAG, hybride) et orchestration de workflows agentiques (LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, patterns ReAct).

Agentic Coding : Acculturation aux workflows de développement assisté (Specify → Plan → Tasks → Implement → Validate) via des outils comme Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou Gemini CLI.


Standardisation d'équipe : Diffusion des bonnes pratiques de gestion de contexte (CLAUDE.md, règles modulaires, génération de tests) et création de serveurs MCP sécurisés.


Pédagogie & Regard Critique : Vulgarisation adaptative (du décideur à l'ingénieur) tout en insufflant une culture de la sécurité (code review, vulnérabilités) et du maintien des compétences en dev classique.


Conseil & Stratégie GenAI
Tu transformes des besoins métiers complexes ou flous en feuilles de route opérationnelles et à fort ROI :


Cadrage & Roadmap : Animation d'ateliers d'idéation, priorisation des cas d'usage (Quick Wins vs Chantiers structurants) et construction du business case pour les sponsors.


Architecture de Solutions : Arbitrages Build vs Buy, conception de couches intermédiaires (Context Graphs) pour maîtriser la dette technique et l'économie du token.


Gouvernance & Change : Accompagnement des instances dirigeantes (COMEX, CODIR) sur la gestion du risque, la conformité et la conduite du changement.



▪️ Le profil idéal

Formation & Parcours : Titulaire d'un Bac+5 en informatique (école d'ingénieur ou Master universitaire) ou bénéficiant d'une solide expérience terrain équivalente dans la conception logicielle et l'architecture système.
Expérience : Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience globale en ingénierie logicielle ou architecture cloud, avec une spécialisation marquée et récente en IA générative, ingénierie de prompt et orchestration agentique. Une première expérience réussie en formation/consulting ou une appétence forte pour la transmission est indispensable.



▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais
L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence.

Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine.
Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).
Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant.

Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.

However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.1. Statistical & Mathematical FoundationsMastery of Core ConceptsMany papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse.Combining Existing Theories in Novel WaysPapers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights.Logical Reasoning and Assumption TestingAcross all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses.2. Algorithmic Innovation & ImplementationCreative Solutions to Known BottlenecksEach paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts.Turning Theory into PracticeWhether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential.Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-SourceMany references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress.3. Data-Driven & Scalable SystemsEmphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient PipelinesPapers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models.Strategic Use of Data for Staged TrainingA recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.4. Hardware & Systems UnderstandingEfficient Implementations at ScaleMany works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.Real-Time & On-Device ConstraintsSoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness.Architectural & Optimization DetailsPapers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency.5. Rigorous Experimental DesignControlled Comparisons & AblationsNearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter.Multifold Evaluation MetricsFrom MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics.Stress Tests & Edge CasesWhisper's out-of-distribution speech benchmarks, SoundStream's evaluation on speech + music, or Mamba-2's performance on multi-query associative recall demonstrate the importance of specialized challenge sets. Researchers who craft or adopt rigorous benchmarks and "red-team" their models (as in phi-3 safety alignment) are better prepared to address real-world complexities.SummaryOverall, an ideal researcher in deep learning consistently demonstrates:A solid grounding in theoretical and statistical principlesA talent for proposing and validating new algorithmic solutionsThe capacity to orchestrate data pipelines that scale and reflect real-world diversityAwareness of hardware constraints and system-level trade-offs for efficiencyThorough and transparent experimental practicesThese qualities surface across research on speech (Whisper, BASE TTS), language modeling (Scaling Laws, phi-3), specialized hardware (TPU, Transformers are SSMs), and new representation methods (VQ-VAE, FSQ, SoundStream). title: Power Markets Analyst (f/m/d)
description_clean:
About Nexun
Backed by Marguerite, a leading pan-European infrastructure fund, Nexun is a fast-growing renewable project development platform active in Spain, France, Germany, Italy, Poland, and Austria. At Nexun, we are passionate advocates for renewable energy as well as grid infrastructure and are committed to accelerating the transition to a low-carbon economy. Join our diverse team to contribute to projects that positively impact communities across Europe.
The Power/Flexibility Markets Analyst leads the commercial development, negotiation, and optimization of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects, including both standalone storage assets and co-located solar-plus-storage projects. The role focuses on identifying best value and route-to-market for our projects, forecasting revenue schemes and offtake contracts possibilities (Tolling Agreements, PPAs), optimizing the commercial design of our plants to derisk projects and maximize their value at the point of sale (RTB) based on a solid market and technical understanding of electricity markets and asset configurations, negotiating PPAs and Tolling agreements.
Target countries: Italy, Poland, France as priority and Spain, Austria and Germany as secondary markets

Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of the electricity markets in at least one of the target countries, including Day-Ahead, Intraday, Ancillary Services, Balancing Markets, Capacity Markets.
Monitor regulatory and market developments and evaluate their impact on the revenues and commercial viability of BESS and solar projects.
Collect, analyze, and develop electricity price forecasts and revenue projections for standalone BESS and hybrid solar-plus-storage projects.
Analyze and compare current route-to-market and optimization models and select and negotiate the optimal role (merchant, tolling, PPA, floor/hybrid structures) for standalone BESS, co-located BESS with photovoltaic (PV) plants, and hybrid renewable energy projects to maximize the RTB value and derisk the projects.
Originate, negotiate, and close Tolling Agreements and Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with offtakers, utilities, traders, on all type of assets (BESS; collocated etc.)
Support the preparation of business cases, investment decisions, financial models, and technical/commercial due diligence processes.
Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across the BESS ecosystem and the different target countries, including utilities, energy traders, optimizers, aggregators, transmission and distribution system operators, regulatory authorities, investors, and asset operators.

Collaborate closely with Development, Engineering, Finance, and external partners throughout the project lifecycle.

Requirements

Good understanding of electricity markets in at least one European target market.
Familiarity with Day-Ahead, Intraday, Balancing, Ancillary Services, Capacity Markets, and other flexibility markets.
Understanding of current revenue optimization and commercialization models for standalone BESS and co-located renewable energy projects.

Strong Excel skills and financial modeling capabilities

Exposure to commercial negotiations, tolling agreements, PPAs, or energy trading is beneficial but not mandatory.

Analytical Capabilities

Comparing 2-hour and 4-hour battery storage systems with respect to CAPEX, OPEX, revenue potential, and Internal Rate of Return (IRR).
Determining the optimal battery size for co-located solar PV projects.
Evaluating revenue allocation across energy arbitrage, balancing services, ancillary services, and other flexibility products.

C’est ici que ça se passe.🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vousCe post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet ANR PRME LINEN (Experimental and Numerical Characterisation of Flax Composite Manufacturing by Liquid Infusion: From Local Phenomena to Induced Properties), auquel participent plusieurs chercheurs de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne, avec pour objectif d’étudier l’élaboration de pièces structurales en matériaux composites à base de fibres de lin.Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 12 mois est proposé pour développer la modélisation numérique de l’infusion de résine dans des préformes composites à fibres de lin. L’objectif est d’étudier, à l’échelle mésoscopique, l’influence de l’organisation anisotrope et hétérogène des torons de fibres sur l’écoulement de la résine. Le projet s’appuiera sur des simulations 3D par éléments finis, reposant sur un couplage Stokes-Darcy et la prise en compte d’un tenseur de perméabilité orthotrope. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’influence des variations locales de la fraction volumique de fibres sur la perméabilité, les chemins préférentiels d’écoulement et les effets capillaires. Dans un premier temps, des architectures idéalisées de type unidirectionnel, quasi-unidirectionnel et tissé seront étudiées à l’aide d’une représentation par Level-Set. Dans un second temps, lorsque cela sera possible, des mésostructures réalistes seront reconstruites à partir d’images µ-CT. Le post-doctorant.e contribuera également au développement et à la validation de la stratégie numérique et travaillera en interaction étroite avec les travaux expérimentaux et numériques des autres tâches du projet.   🔍 Ce que nous recherchonsUne formation en mécanique numérique, mécanique des fluides, éléments finis ou calcul scientifique est recherchée. title: Senior Integrated Photonics Packaging Engineer (m/f/d)
description_clean: Your missionThe future of AI computing is light, not electrons. As Senior Integrated Photonics Packaging Engineer, you will sit at the very heart of Q.ANT’s photonic hardware R&D. You will research, develop, and demonstrate novel electrical and optical packaging concepts that bring our photonic integrated circuits (PICs) to their full performance potential. Rather than managing external suppliers to deliver off-the-shelf solutions, you will own the hands-on development of packaging architectures end-to-end - from first-principles design through prototyping, benchtop characterization, and validation. We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer profile who will design and implement the Pigment infrastructure for tomorrow. Pigment is a technically challenging platform. It calculates and synchronizes large datasets that must be updated in real-time. Data comes from client models that can be up to billions of rows. This data can be pivoted, transformed, and aggregated on-demand through our formula engine while rendering live on our front end.
Here are the challenges to be tackled as a Senior Platform Engineer:

Define and build the infrastructure needed to answer our performance challenges, automate it, and make it scalable. In particular, ensure that the infrastructure scales in and out according to the platform usage.
Secure high availability and redundancy of the Pigment platform.
Ensure that the platform’s performance and correctness are monitored accordingly, spread observability best practices across the engineering team.
Participate in incident response.
Accompany Pigment geographical expansion as the company grows and we sign clients overseas.
Work with our security team on the implementation of their roadmap when related to infrastructure and development pipelines (code repository, credentials management, ...)
Continuously chase inefficiencies within our development practices and pipelines. Seek improvement and automation wherever possible. Drive change across the software engineering team.

In addition to Platform responsibilities, we expect you to contribute to software development activities. This is not limited to scripting and automations - we expect to you to be fully capable of reading and writing code. We believe Senior Platform Engineers should collaborate closely with software engineers, fostering a shared understanding of day-to-day challenges, rather than operating in separate teams. Last but not least, you will not be alone! You will be part of an SRE team.
 
Our Engineering team
Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product.
Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between the infrastructure, backend, and the frontend.
 
We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology.
Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership and team spirit.
 
Technical stack:

Kubernetes (GKE, hosted on Google Cloud Platform): hosting all our infrastructure components except some PostgreSQL hosts, hosted on Google Cloud SQL
Terraform: all our infrastructure is managed via this infrastructure as code (creation of GKE clusters, Google Cloud SQL databases, GCS buckets, IAM permissions...)
Databases: PostgreSQL (CloudSQL and CloudNativePG), SingleStore, ElasticSearch
RabbitMQ: queuing system
Temporal.io: workflow automation platform
Others: ArgoCD, Istio, Vault, Github, Docker (for local development)

Frontend: React + Typescript, Jest, Cypress, Vite...

 
Who you are
 
More than knowledge of a specific cloud provider, language, or automation framework, we are looking for great engineering skills: the ability to translate product requirements into an elegant and simple architecture, and then make sure our product runs well on it.

Experience as a software engineer & Platform Engineer. Hands on coding is a must for this role.
Experience with a container orchestration platform (Kubernetes is a plus)
Experience with a public cloud provider, GCP is a plus
Proven experience in software developments with languages such as C#, Java, C++, Golang, Rust, JavaScript, Python, or Ruby (this list is not exhaustive).
Experience with observability tools (e.g. Datadog, Prometheus, ELK, Jaeger...)
Great team spirit with a problem-solving attitude.
A good dose of humility and the willingness to grow (no matter your seniority!).
Fluency in English

Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.The Role Heidi sits in an unusual position. We lead a category being built for the first time. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians found us on their own, started using the product for free, and told a colleague. The market is open, and we're in the privileged position of clinicians already liking the product. Your job is to turn those smaller-scale use cases into enterprise deals.You're the first line to Heidi in France. Inbound demand connects you with cabinets, maisons de santé, and hospital groups already using us, and you decide whether to qualify each one in, out, or close it yourself. Where the signals run thin, you build the outbound.For most clinicians, you'll be the first person from Heidi they ever speak to. You'll both triage inbound to Account Executives where needed and close your own deals from day one, because we want people as close to the frontline as possible. You'll build a network across French healthcare that outlasts the role.What you’ll doWork the inbound queue and the warm product signals across France. Your day goes to clinicians and cabinets already using Heidi, where the product tells you who's outgrown the free version.Build outbound where the signals are thin: pick the practice groups, maisons de santé and hospital groups worth going after and work them in French.Research the accounts behind those signals, work out who else in the cabinet or hospital group needs to be in the conversation, and build the case for each one.Reach the people the signals point to, across calls, email and social, while the interest is still fresh.Book demos and meetings for your AEs with enough context that nothing is lost in the handoff.Own SMB deals end to end, from first conversation through to closed.Keep HubSpot accurate, keep the pipeline moving and hit your qualified-lead number every month.Partner with AEs, Marketing, Product, Operations and Customer Success so what you promise on the call matches what clinicians get, and so the French-language product and collateral keep up with what you hear.Track what's shifting in French healthcare (regulation, the practice and hospital groups, Assurance Maladie and the mutuelles, the competitive set) and tell the team what you're hearing on the phones.What you'll needNative or fluent French, and English that allows you to work in a global team.You've worked somewhere with a high bar, whether that's tech, sales, creative, banking, consulting, or PE/VC. We care more about what you've achieved than your time in a sales role.You care about what we do. You'd rather learn how the product works than memorise a pitch.You can hold a conversation with anyone and get to the point of it fast. Clinicians have extremely busy schedules, so you need to respect that and still get the meeting.Knowing how French healthcare buys (who decides in a cabinet, a maison de santé or a hospital group, and who pays) is a head start. If you don't know it yet, you're the type who'd learn it in your first weeks.Organised and self-running. You run your own list, your own day and your own follow-ups without being chased.Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping or side projects.You default to building over requesting.You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. At Heidi, great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.Attitude is more important than experience, so if you are a hungry, competitive and highly motivated operator who has a knack for problem-solving and building relationships, we want to hear from you.How we show upBuild for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.Why Heidi?You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. description_clean:
Who is Sonar?
Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.
Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.
We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:


SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.


SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.


SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.


Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:


Committed to our customers and community.


Obsessed with quality.


Deliberate in our decisions.


Effective as one team.


With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description
 
As a member of one of our engineering teams, you'll be a key player in making SonarQube Cloud and SonarQube Server the best tools for Code Quality and Security, providing new features to deliver high-quality and powerful products and services that help our users write better software. 
 
You will have the opportunity to see your features come to life in Production with short iteration loops. While keeping our roadmap and business priorities in mind, you will be able to have a high impact on the software that we own and develop.
 
By joining us you will bring your experience and expertise to help push our product to its next stage of evolution and fulfill the needs of our large user and customer base.What you will do
Lead and manage a team of Engineers (Cloud Engineers and Site Reliability Engineers), providing guidance, support, and mentorship to help individuals grow in autonomy and master the complexities of cloud operations.
Hold yourself and your team accountable to high engineering standards, specifically focusing on system reliability, performance, and security.
Manage the team’s operational workload, including on-call health, incident response, and the reduction of manual toil through automation.
Foster a safe culture of feedback and continuous improvement, encouraging the team to conduct blameless post-mortems and share architectural insights.
Collaborate with other  value stream squads to ensure the production platform meets the needs of our developers while maintaining strict governance.
Communicate a clear vision for the squad that aligns with the platform engineering roadmap, focusing on resiliency, business continuity, and cost optimization.
Partner with the Hiring team to recruit talented Engineers for the team. Participate in improving the hiring process for the team and ensuring we recruit enough to reach our goals.
Lead by example, modeling behaviors of servant leadership and high-stakes decision-making.
Experience and qualifications
8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a significant focus on Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Operations, or Infrastructure Engineering.
Operational Mindset: Deep understanding of the DevOps/SRE mindset, including experience managing mission-critical shared services (e.g., Aurora DBs, OpenSearch, Control Planes).
Cloud Expertise: Advanced knowledge of AWS (or similar providers) and experience managing organizational-scale infrastructure (IAM, OUs, Account Vending).
Infrastructure as Code: Experience with the coding lifecycle in an infrastructure context (e.g., Python, CDK, Terraform) and the ability to perform rigorous code reviews for infrastructure components.
Observability & Resiliency: Proven experience defining observability patterns (logging, tracing, metrics) and designing Disaster Recovery/Business Continuity strategies.
Agile & FinOps: Experience with Agile methodologies and a strong understanding of cloud cost optimization (Rightsizing, Spot instances, Reserved Instances).

title: Senior Manager Accounting & Controlling (m/w/d)
description_clean: Die ChanceIm Mittelstand wird das Rechnungswesen in Teile zerlegt und weitergegeben. Einer bucht, einer baut den Abschluss, einer spricht mit dem Unternehmer. Am Ende kennt niemand das Unternehmen ganz, und der Inhaber bekommt Zahlen, mit denen er nicht steuern kann.Vogel erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen und baut sie zur stärksten Adresse ihrer Region aus. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Für diese Unternehmen übernehmen wir das Rechnungswesen vollständig: die laufende Verarbeitung mit hohem Automatisierungsgrad, die handelsrechtliche Bilanzierung und darauf aufbauend Auswertung, Planung und Controlling.Du führst deine Mandate vollständig durch die Zahlen, vom laufenden Rechnungswesen über den Abschluss bis in das Gespräch, in dem der Unternehmer seine Entscheidungen trifft. Es gibt keine Schnittstelle, an der du übergibst. Du führst ein Team und berichtest an die Geschäftsführung.Was du verantwortestRechnungswesen und BilanzierungVerantworte das laufende Rechnungswesen deiner Mandate unter hohem Automatisierungsgrad und steigere diesen Grad weiter, statt Handarbeit zu verwalten. Dein Maßstab ist nicht, dass die Zahlen am Ende stimmen, sondern wie wenig manueller Aufwand dafür nötig war.Verantworte den handelsrechtlichen Jahresabschluss samt Anhang und Bericht als eigenständiges Ergebnis für den Unternehmer, nicht als Vorstufe der Steuererklärung.Definier, wann ein Abschluss abschlussfähig ist, und mach daraus einen Standard, der auch unter Fristendruck trägt, samt Vier-Augen-Regime in der Linie.Steuerung und BeratungFühr das Monats- oder Quartalsgespräch mit dem Unternehmer und übersetz die Zahlen in eine Handlungslinie. Dein Maßstab: Er kann danach entscheiden, nicht nur eine Zahl wiederholen.Bau Planung und Steuerung auf dem laufenden Rechnungswesen auf: Ergebnis-, Bilanz- und Liquiditätsplanung mit Szenarien, Forecast, Soll-Ist-Abgleich, Deckungsbeitrag.Begleite Finanzierungen und Bankgespräche, bereite ratingfähig auf und zeig die Liquiditätsreserven, die im Working Capital und im Forderungsmanagement liegen.Team und StandardFühr dein Team fachlich und disziplinarisch: Review, Eskalations-Entscheidungen, Leistungsgespräche, Mitwirkung im Einstellungsprozess.Entwickle die Erfahrungsstufen in deiner Linie weiter. Wer welchen Abschluss baut und wer welches Steuerungsgespräch führt, ist eine Frage von Befähigung, nicht von Dienstalter.Schneid die Steuerungsleistungen so zu, dass sie wiederkehrend tragen und mit dem Mandatsvolumen skalieren, statt bei jedem Mandat neu erfunden zu werden.Fragen, auf die du die Antwort findestEin Mandant will die Steuerungsleistung nicht zahlen, weil sie der Steuerberater bisher mitgemacht hat. Wie grenzt du den Wert ab, und wo hältst du das Honorar?Wann ist ein Abschluss abschlussfähig, und was tust du, wenn der Termin drückt und der Standard nicht erreicht ist?Welche Auswertung braucht wirklich jeder Mandant, und welche nur der, der danach fragt?Woran wir Erfolg messenNach 6 Monaten: Rund zehn handelsrechtliche Abschlüsse in eigener Verantwortung abgeschlossen und dabei den Standard gesetzt. Das Vier-Augen-Regime läuft, die ersten Steuerungsgespräche hast du selbst geführt, und du kennst dein Team persönlich.Nach 12 Monaten: Mindestens fünf Mandate im laufenden Rechnungswesen um rund zwanzig Prozent effizienter, messbar an Durchlaufzeit und Handarbeitsanteil. Mindestens ein Steuerungsthema über die Finanzbuchführung hinaus läuft bei mehreren Mandaten.Nach 24 Monaten: Ein Qualitätsniveau, das über den Bestand messbar ist und nicht an einzelnen Personen hängt. Die Beratungsleistung auf dem Rechnungswesen trägt als wiederkehrende Umsatzlinie, und dein Team ist über die erste Ebene hinaus gewachsen.Wohin es führt: in die Verantwortung für Accounting und Controlling über mehrere Standorte. Das ist die Management-Karriere, entschieden an einer Linie, die den Standard eigenständig trägt, und nicht am Berufsjahr.Was du mitbringstDu hast das Wirtschaftsprüfer-Examen bestanden oder stehst kurz davor, oder du trägst seit mehreren Jahren die Verantwortung für handelsrechtliche Abschlüsse mittelständischer Gesellschaften.Du hast Abschlüsse nicht nur geprüft, sondern erstellt, und kennst den Unterschied zwischen einem Abschluss, der formal steht, und einem, der eine Aussage trifft.Du hast wirtschaftlichen Sachverstand schon direkt zum Unternehmer getragen und nicht nur an eine Führungskraft berichtet.Du beherrschst die HGB-Bilanzierung im Mittelstand mit ihren echten Streitpunkten, von der Bestandsbewertung über unfertige Leistungen bis zu Gesellschafterkonten, und kannst deine Position vertreten.Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug für Plausibilisierung, Anomalie-Erkennung in Kontenbewegungen, Planungslogiken und Drafting.Du hältst den Qualitätsstandard, auch wenn der Termin drückt, bringst die Demut mit, von Praktikern zu lernen, und setzt in allem den höchsten Standard, weil Mittelmaß für dich keine Option ist.Ein Plus, keine BedingungDie Mechanik von Planung und Finanzierung: integrierte Mehrjahresplanung, Investitionsrechnung, Rating-Logik gegenüber Banken.Genug steuerliches Gespür, um zu erkennen, wann eine handelsrechtliche Entscheidung steuerlich relevant wird. Die Lösung musst du nicht selbst kennen.Kein kanonischer Lebenslauf nötig: Bilanzbuchhalter mit langjähriger eigener Abschlussverantwortung, der faktisch schon das Steuerungsgespräch geführt hat; Steuerberater mit Rechnungswesen- und Controlling-Schwerpunkt; Prüfer aus dem Verbundbereich mit Mittelstands-Tiefe. Wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett; die ausgewiesene Spanne bezieht sich auf das Primärprofil, und ein anderer Hintergrund startet zu einem anderen Marktpreis und konvergiert nach zwölf Monaten bewährter Leistung auf das Rollen-Niveau.Was diese Rolle ist, und was nichtDieselben Unternehmen über Jahre, kein Prüfungszyklus. Du siehst, was aus deiner Arbeit wird, statt einmal im Jahr zu testieren und wieder zu gehen.Bilanz und Gespräch, kein reines Controlling. Du trägst den Abschluss selbst. Wer die Zahlen nur interpretieren will, ist hier falsch.Gestalten, kein fertiges Regelwerk. Wie der Standard aussieht, wie weit die Automatisierung geht und welche Steuerungsleistungen wir anbieten, entscheidest du mit.Warum VogelEin Mandat, eine Hand. Kein Übergeben, keine Schnittstelle. Dein Abschluss ist die Grundlage deines eigenen Beratungsgesprächs, und das gibt es im Markt selten.Die Fleißarbeit nimmt dir das System ab. Erfassung und Abstimmung laufen weitgehend maschinell, und unser eigener Jahresabschluss mit KI ist der Beleg. Was bleibt, ist Beurteilung und das Gespräch.Du willst entscheiden: Abschluss-Standard, Vier-Augen-Regime und Aufstellung deines Teams. Vogel ist hierarchisch in der Entscheidung, flach in der Kommunikation, autonom in der Ausführung. Leistung wird gefeiert, nicht versteckt, ohne Konsens-Theater.Substanz im Rücken. Ein profitables, wachsendes Unternehmen mit etablierten Mandanten. Der Bestand ist da, du musst ihn nicht erst gewinnen.FAQ1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr?Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen.2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick.3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns.5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values.6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es?Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt.Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. description_clean:
About Legend
At Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.
Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.
The Role
Legend is hiring a Senior SEO Specialist, reporting directly to our Head of SEO.
This isn’t a traditional SEO role focused on optimising pages one by one. You’ll take ownership of SEO performance across key markets and complex initiatives, but you’ll also have the opportunity to zoom out, work with large datasets and help shape how we approach SEO at scale.
We’re investing in a more data-led, strategic and AI-enabled way of working, and you’ll play a key role in driving that forward. You’ll identify opportunities to use AI and automation, challenge existing processes and develop scalable solutions that can deliver meaningful impact across the wider SEO team.
You’ll have existing roadmaps, best practices and early AI experimentation to build from, but the autonomy to shape longer-term priorities and challenge how things are done. Whether you’re analysing the impact of changes across thousands of URLs, identifying strategic opportunities across markets or developing automated QA workflows, you’ll be expected to connect the dots, influence decisions and drive improvements across our portfolio.
We’re looking for an experienced SEO who combines strong analytical thinking with strategic judgement, thrives on solving complex problems and is excited by what AI and automation could unlock. You don’t need to be an AI expert. What matters is that you’re already exploring its potential, can identify where it will add real value and have the confidence to turn ideas into scalable improvements.
In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.Your Impact:
Own and drive SEO performance across key markets or complex initiatives, shaping longer-term roadmaps, identifying growth opportunities and ensuring priorities align with wider business objectives.
Turn complex datasets and competitor insights into strategic action, identifying patterns, anticipating challenges and influencing SEO priorities across markets and teams.
Drive the adoption of AI and automation within SEO workflows, identifying high-impact opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability and quality.
Design, test and implement scalable automation workflows that improve how the wider SEO team operates, including opportunities to transform areas such as SEO QA.
Lead analysis of wider changes across our portfolio, translating findings into clear strategic recommendations and influencing cross-functional teams to deliver measurable improvements.
Help shape the future of SEO at Legend, challenging existing processes, driving continuous improvement and sharing your expertise to help others adopt smarter, more scalable ways of working.

What You'll Bring:
Deep SEO expertise, particularly across on-page optimisation, with strong technical SEO knowledge and experience developing strategies that deliver measurable improvements across large, complex websites.
Advanced analytical skills, with experience working with complex datasets, identifying trends and translating insights into strategic recommendations that influence longer-term priorities.
A proactive approach to AI and automation, with experience identifying opportunities, experimenting with solutions and improving workflows to deliver greater efficiency and scalability.
A proven ability to independently own complex SEO initiatives, prioritise opportunities based on impact and effort, and deliver measurable outcomes while navigating cross-functional dependencies.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex analysis, challenge assumptions and influence decisions across teams through evidence-backed recommendations.
The strategic thinking, autonomy and adaptability to solve ambiguous problems, anticipate challenges and drive improvements beyond your immediate area of responsibility.

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. 
Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.
Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

You would join the Insurance Platform team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would take technical leadership in that team, and shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.
The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.
Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.
As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together.
You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth.

Taking technical leadership within a team, owning the wider picture: what you ship as a team end to end, and the operational health of what we run

TypeScript across the board, running on AWS (IaaC), in a single monorepo. If you have not worked with all of it, that is fine. We care more about how you reason about systems than about which tools you have used before.

You build the solution, rather than handing it to another team.

Extract, clean and reconcile financial data across our accounting, banking and carrier systems, including premium, commission and claims positions across multiple insurance carrier partners
Write your own SQL to query our data warehouse and financial systems, and your own Python to clean, match, reconcile and analyse data that Excel cannot handle well
Build and maintain the scripts and small tools the finance team runs on: reconciliation scripts, carrier statement parsers, checks that flag unreconciled items automatically, and pipelines that turn a one-off analysis into a repeatable, scheduled workflow
Use Claude and other AI tools as part of your daily toolkit to write, debug and document your code, explore data and speed up analysis, while staying accountable for the result
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting tools (for example in QuickSight and Excel/Sheets) that give the business real-time visibility into cash, receivables and payables
Identify trends, anomalies and unreconciled items in financial datasets, and drive them to root cause rather than just flagging them
Support forecasting, budgeting and cash flow planning with data-driven insight, including carrier-related working capital exposure
Automate recurring finance workflows (for example via n8n) that connect our operational tools to our financial systems
Partner with accounting and finance on VAT, insurance premium tax and other compliance-related reporting across our markets
Improve data quality, financial controls and reporting processes as the company and its entity structure grow

You reconcile positions across multiple counterparties (bank accounts, receivables, payables) and explain discrepancies, not just report them
You use AI-assisted tools for data cleaning, analysis and reporting as a matter of course
You communicate clearly in English, verbally and in writing, to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike; we work with an international team, so English is our daily working language.

Hybrid working from our office in Amsterdam
Room for training (for example in data, BI or finance certifications) and growth as the company grows

Je bent goed in je vak. Je weet hoe je een dossier snel doorgrondt, wanneer een expert nodig is en hoe je een beslissing uitlegt aan een klant die net een vervelende dag heeft. Wat je waarschijnlijk mist, is invloed op hoe dat werk georganiseerd is: de systemen, de processen, de goede ideeën die blijven liggen.
Bij Insify verandert dat. Je behandelt schades op het gebied van bedrijfsaansprakelijkheid, beroepsaansprakelijkheid en inventaris en goederen. Daarnaast doe je de intakes van klanten die arbeidsongeschikt raken en behandel je bezwaren op AOV-claims. Je doet dit in een klein, scherp team, als gevolmachtigde van grote verzekeraars en herverzekeraars. Dat betekent een duidelijk eigen mandaat vanaf dag één en rechtstreeks contact met de risicodragers, zonder tussenlagen.
Je krijgt snel een compleet beeld, ook op afstand, en je weet wanneer een zaak externe expertise nodig heeft en wanneer niet. Je onderbouwt je beslissingen goed, richting klant én verzekeraar. En binnen je mandaat bepaal je zelf hoe je werkt: geen bureaucratie, wel jouw inzicht en de vrijheid om ernaar te handelen.

Wij zetten technologie en AI in om het repetitieve werk uit je dag te halen, zodat jij je tijd kunt besteden aan de zaken waar een mens echt het verschil maakt. Jij bepaalt mee wat we automatiseren, wat we juist niet automatiseren en hoe we onze fraudedetectie scherper maken. Intake, behandeling en afwikkeling van zakelijke schades (aansprakelijkheid, inventaris en goederen)
Intakes van klanten die arbeidsongeschikt raken, en behandeling van bezwaren op AOV-claims
Contact met experts, advocaten en andere verzekeraars
Rechtstreeks schakelen met onze verzekeraars en herverzekeraars
Klanten te woord staan, ondersteunen en adviseren, ook als het nieuws niet leuk is
Andere teams binnen Insify scherper maken met wat jij in dossiers ziet: van product tot acceptatie

Ervaring met AOV-claims is een pre, nieuwsgierigheid ernaar is een must

Je bent kritisch en analytisch, en je durft een beslissing te nemen en die uit te leggen

Hybride werken vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam 
Ruimte voor opleiding (bijvoorbeeld Wft Schade of AOV-verdieping) en groei met het bedrijf mee
Insify Pensioenplan met 6% werkgeversbijdrage
Reiskostenvergoeding voor je woon-werkverkeer
25 vakantiedagen per jaar, plus 24 december als die op een doordeweekse dag valt
Tot 4 weken per jaar remote werken
€50 Alleo-budget per maand, te besteden aan wat jij wilt – sporten, eten, whatever

Over Insify
Zakelijke verzekeringen moeten anders. Insify is ontstaan uit onze frustratie met hoe traditionele verzekeraars werken: traag, omslachtig en onpersoonlijk. Wij maken verzekeren voor ondernemers simpel, snel en eerlijk. Van het moment dat iemand klant wordt tot de laatste stap van een claim.

title: Claims Analyst (Remote in the Netherlands)
description_clean:
Over ons
 
Steeds meer mensen in Europa kiezen ervoor om zelfstandig te werken als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Zelfstandig werken biedt vrijheid en flexibiliteit om te bepalen wanneer, hoe en met wie je wilt werken. Het zien groeien van je eigen bedrijf kan zowel professioneel als financieel belonend zijn.
 
Zelfstandig zijn brengt echter ook onzekerheden met zich mee. De juiste verzekeringen zijn essentieel om voorbereid te zijn op de risico’s van het ondernemerschap.
 
Bij Insify bieden we transparante, flexibele en eerlijk geprijsde verzekeringen, afgestemd op de behoeften van ondernemers. Zo kunnen zij zich volledig richten op hun werk, in de wetenschap dat ze altijd op ons kunnen rekenen.
Insify verzekert duizenden klanten in heel Europa. Wij bieden betrouwbare verzekeringen zonder ingewikkeld papierwerk. Een verzekering bij Insify sluit je 100% digitaal af, vandaag geregeld is morgen verzekerd.
 
Hoe wij werken
 
Bij Insify hebben we vier kernwaarden: doorzettingsvermogen, impact, zorg en ondernemerschap. Die leggen we kort even uit:
Doorzettingsvermogen: We zijn niet bang voor uitdagingen en gaan juist door waar anderen stoppen.
Impact: We maken het verschil in het leven van onze klanten en belonen hun vertrouwen in ons. 
Zorg: Wij stellen onze klanten altijd centraal. Hun succes is ons doel.
Ondernemerschap: Innovatie zit in ons DNA. We gaan snel en we denken groot.  
 
Bij Insify word je onderdeel van een hecht team. Daarom werken we het liefst zo veel mogelijk op kantoor. Dat klinkt misschien raar voor een 100% online verzekeraar, maar wij geloven dat een sterke onderlinge band ons helpt sneller te innoveren en onze klanten nog beter te bedienen. Zo’n band is eigenlijk alleen via persoonlijk contact te realiseren.
Door regelmatig naar kantoor te komen, leren nieuwe collega’s bovendien sneller en voelen ze zich eerder thuis.
 
We begrijpen ook dat je misschien niet elke dag naar kantoor kunt komen of dat er momenten zijn dat je je focus nodig hebt. Daarom is gedeeltelijk thuiswerken in overleg mogelijk.
 
Operations Team
 
Wij zijn degenen die vertrouwen opbouwen bij elk contactmoment—of het nu om een verkoop, een supportgesprek of het afhandelen van een claim gaat. We zorgen ervoor dat prospects en klanten zich gesteund, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Snelheid en kwaliteit zijn voor ons belangrijk, en we volgen onze voortgang nauwgezet zodat we blijven verbeteren. Met het oog op de toekomst bereiden we ons voor op medische acceptatie in 2025—een volgende stap om onze service nóg sterker te maken.Jouw rol
 
 
We zijn op zoek naar een Claims Handler die verder kijkt dan alleen schade
 
Bij Insify bouwen we niet zomaar aan een goede schadeafhandeling—we bouwen aan de beste. Eén die persoonlijk én slim is. Waarbij technologie ons werk makkelijker maakt, en onze klanten sneller en eerlijker geholpen worden. Daar hebben we jou voor nodig.
 
Als Claims Handler bij Insify ben je niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor het behandelen van schades (denk aan bedrijfsaansprakelijkheid, beroepsaansprakelijkheid, inventaris- en goederen), maar werk je ook actief mee aan het verbeteren van onze processen. Je bent onderdeel van een klein team dat grote dingen doet—als gevolmachtigde van een internationale (her)verzekeraar werk je direct mee aan dossiers, intakes van arbeidsongeschiktheidsclaims (AOV) en bezwaarprocedures.
 
Maar dat is nog maar het begin.
Jouw rol gaat verder dan het traditionele. Je helpt met het trainen van onze AI, werkt aan de ontwikkeling van een claimsplatform dat schaalbaar is voor meerdere EU-markten, en denkt mee over hoe we technologie kunnen inzetten om repetitief werk te automatiseren zonder het persoonlijke contact te verliezen. Oftewel: je bouwt mee aan de toekomst van verzekeren.Dit doet een Claim Analyst bij Insify:
Intake, behandeling en afwikkeling van schades
Behandelen van arbeidsongeschiktheidsintakes en bezwaren (AOV)
Klanten ondersteunen met empathie én expertise
Contact met experts, advocaten, verzekeraars en herverzekeraars
Meedenken over procesoptimalisatie, AI-training en automatisering
Bouwen aan een innovatieve schadeaanpak voor meerdere Europese landen
Jouw profiel
Je hebt 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring met de behandeling van zakelijke schades
Ervaring met AOV-claims is een pre
Je bent in het bezit van een WFT Basis, WFT Schade particulier/zakelijk is een pré.
Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke vaardigheid, zowel in de Nederlandse als Engelse taal
Je bent kritisch en hebt een sterk analytisch vermogen
Je durft beslissingen te nemen
Je bent proactief, oplossingsgericht en pragmatisch
Je werkt efficiënt en nauwkeurig
Wat wij bieden
 
Concurrerende vergoeding - We willen de besten aantrekken en behouden, daarom bieden we een compensatiepakket dat daarbij past.
Pensioenregeling - Deelname aan Insify’s pensioenplan, met 6% werkgeversbijdrage.
Reiskostenvergoeding - We helpen reizigers met hun woon-werkverkeer.
Hybride werken - Mogelijkheid om twee keer per week vanuit huis te werken. Als ervaren professional kun je remote werken en kom je af en toe naar kantoor.
25 vakantiedagen per jaar - (+ een extra dag op kerstavond als het een werkdag is!)
Abonnement op Alleo - 50 EUR (netto) maandelijks (op te sparen) budget om uit te geven aan wat je wilt - van sportschoolabonnementen tot UberEats!
Leuke events - Maandelijkse team drinks, kwartaal uitjes, lunch & learns, feesten, merch en FUN!
Bedrijfs MacBook - Krijg de beste laptop om je werk snel en efficiënt te doen!
Snelle carrièreontwikkeling - Er is geen betere plek om je carrière te ontwikkelen. Wij groeien en jij kunt met ons meegroeien! Interne leiderschapsprogramma’s en coaching.

We are looking for a Senior Treasury Manager to build and run Finom's treasury function.

Today the function is up and running: the money is placed, the investment policy is in place, and a large part of the book sits with an external asset manager. What we are building now is the machinery around it — an evidenced limit framework, look-through into what our managers actually hold, automated investment accounting, and a reconciled NII number we can defend to an auditor and a regulator.
That is the job. You will take part in building it, and you will run it while it is being built.
This is a hands-on role at the intersection of regulation, liquidity, and commercial impact — not a back-office position. It suits someone who has done this before in a regulated environment and wants to do it again without four layers of committee above them.

Daily liquidity positioning and float management across entities and accounts
Intraday funding of payment channels; nostro and correspondent account management
Collateral and minimum-balance obligations across card schemes, T2, and credit providers
Contingency funding — the playbook for the day we need €20m by tomorrow morning
A daily treasury balance sheet — net liquidity and net capital available — that reconciles

Portfolio management of safeguarded client funds: term deposits, MMFs, short-dated debt, held directly and via external managers
Safeguarding adequacy: shortfall detection, top-up execution, same-currency discipline
Instrument eligibility screening under CRR risk-weight, maturity and WAL constraints, and UCITS/MMF rules

NII forecasting, attribution, and reconciled performance reporting; treasury inputs into the financial model and company forecast

Ownership of the investment policy, limit framework, and eligible-instrument register

title: Pricing/ Commercial Strategy Manager (w/m/d)
description_clean:
Über IONOS
Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools. 
Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen. 
Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns.
Als Pricing/ Commercial Strategy Manager bist du für die Preis- und Werbestrategie deiner Produktfamilien über nationale und internationale Marken hinweg verantwortlich. Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement, dem Marketing und weiteren Teams entwickelst du E-Commerce-Strategien, die Umsätze, Wachstum und Marktanteile steigern. Du analysierst Wettbewerber sowie Markttrends und optimierst die Positionierung von Produkten, Preisen und Angeboten.
Du arbeitest an strategisch wichtigen Marken und Produktlinien mit hoher Sichtbarkeit im Management sowie ehrgeizigen Wachstumszielen und treibst die Weiterentwicklung unserer Kommerz- und Preisstrategie voran.
Aufgabenbereich

Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Online Pricing- und Promotion-Strategien zur Steigerung von Umsatz, Profitabilität, Neukundengewinnung und Marktanteilen.
Durchführung von Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Preisanalysen sowie Aufbau und Pflege von Benchmarks zur Bewertung unserer Produkt- und Preispositionierung.
Planung, Umsetzung und Erfolgsmessung von Pricing- und Promotion-Kampagnen über verschiedene Kanäle.
Entwicklung und Steuerung von Pricing-Roadmaps im Einklang mit den Unternehmenszielen.
Analyse relevanter Commercial Performance-Kennzahlen und Ableitung von Maßnahmen bei Abweichungen.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management, Marketing, Sales und weiteren Teams.
Entwicklung zielgruppenspezifischer Angebote und Kommunikation sowie Beobachtung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen.

Qualifikationen

Bachelorabschluss in BWL, VWL, Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Pricing, Marketing oder Product Management, idealerweise im Online-, IT-/Technologieumfeld.
Sehr gute analytische und problemlösungsorientierte Fähigkeiten sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit komplexen Daten.

Erfahrung und starkes Interesse an der Nutzung von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag, z. B. der Einsatz von Generativer KI zur Synthese von Marktanalysen und für die Datenmodellierung.

description_clean:

Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action.
Tasks

Structure ambiguous, company-level questions into sharp analysis and clear recommendations that shape executive and board decisions.

Build the operating rhythms such as goal-setting, reporting, and business reviews that let a fast-scaling team execute without losing focus.
Act as a trusted proxy for the CEO across internal and external meetings, representing their priorities and following through on decisions.
Support special projects across strategy, operations, and fundraising, contributing to business priorities.

Requirements
WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

2+ years in top-tier management consulting, or a comparable strategy, investment, or high-growth startup background.
A track record of owning ambiguous, cross-functional problems and driving them to a measurable outcome with limited direction.
Strong structured problem-solving, with excellent Excel and PowerPoint skills and the ability to turn messy data into a clear recommendation.
Sharp written and verbal communication that earns trust with senior leaders, investors, and cross-functional teams.
Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment, switching fluidly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
Fluency in English is required; German is a plus.
A valid working permit in Germany.

Benefits

A mission that matters: Join a rapidly growing, dynamic team of international changemakers who are passionate about solving the world’s most pressing challenge and help shape a sustainable, net-zero future.
